summary.en: Basel statistics reports 62 days with Rhine water temperature above 20°C in 2024. This is a river-station observation, not population heat exposure or an eFUA climate score; the 2025 figure is explicitly partial-year.
summary.zh: 巴塞尔统计局记录 2024 年莱茵河水温超过 20°C 共 62 天。这是河流测站观察，不是居民热暴露或 eFUA 气候分数；页面的 2025 数字明确为未满年度。

sources.title: Von Wogen und Wellen: Abfluss und Wassertemperatur im Rhein

summary.en: Local German-language search found no comparable Basel cross-border conflict-exposure series. Swiss BABS supplies an armed-conflict scenario, not a Basel event rate; national scenarios cannot certify absence of war risk.
summary.zh: 本地德文检索未找到可比的巴塞尔跨境冲突暴露序列。瑞士 BABS 提供武装冲突情景，不是巴塞尔事件率；国家情景不能证明无战争风险。

sources.title: BABS KNS2025 Gefährdungsdossiers — Bewaffneter Konflikt
sources.period: 2025 scenario catalogue; not observed event frequency

summary.en: The 2023 Basel-Stadt resident survey publishes response counts for public-safety satisfaction: 549 very satisfied and 972 rather satisfied. Denominator eligibility and nonresponse must be retained; canton residents are not the cross-border eFUA.
summary.zh: 2023 年 Basel-Stadt 居民调查公开公共安全满意度回答数：非常满意 549、比较满意 972。须保留答题资格与无回应；州居民样本不等于跨境 eFUA。

summary.en: IWB reports 17.7 million m³ of drinking-water sales in 2025. Volume is an operator observation, not reserve margin, affordability or outage resilience, and its service area differs from the eFUA.
summary.zh: IWB 报告 2025 年饮用水销量 1,770 万立方米。销量是运营者观察，不等于余量、可负担性或停供韧性，供水区域也不等于 eFUA。

summary.en: USB's 2025 report documents the Claraspital acquisition and discusses cross-canton access under insurance rules. This establishes provider change, not uniform resident access or eFUA service quality; provider consolidation changes comparability.
summary.zh: USB 的 2025 年报记载收购 Claraspital，并讨论医保规则下的跨州准入。它证明服务机构变化，不证明居民均等准入或整个 eFUA 医疗质量；机构合并影响跨年可比性。

summary.en: The inspected Basel longevity study concerns C. elegans dietary RNA mechanisms. Human translation and resident access were not established; this cannot qualify as a local clinical longevity outcome.
summary.zh: 核查的巴塞尔长寿研究是线虫饮食 RNA 机制研究。尚未建立人体转化和居民准入证据，不能作为本地临床长寿结果。

sources.title: Longevity-Forschung: Gesünder im Alter durch Stress

summary.en: BaselTech was established in October 2025 and officially launched in March 2026. A programme launch is verified, but realised nonmedical adoption, productivity and coverage are not measured by this announcement.
summary.zh: BaselTech 于 2025 年 10 月成立、2026 年 3 月正式启动。可核实的是项目启动；公告不测量非医疗技术实际采用、生产率或覆盖率。

summary.en: EuroAirport reports 9.6 million passengers in 2025. This is a trinational airport-flow observation; it does not measure individual exit rights, affordability or emergency route availability.
summary.zh: EuroAirport 报告 2025 年旅客吞吐量 960 万。这是三国地区机场流量观察，不测量个人退出权利、可负担性或紧急航路可用性。

boundaryReview.en: Review completed: original Swiss eFUA 935 and German eFUA 2227 have zero overlapping 1 km cells and union area 820 km². The frozen union is documented; it is not the full trinational metro. The remaining unresolved issue is the mapping of Basel-Stadt, IWB and EuroAirport observations to that union.
boundaryReview.zh: 审核已完成：原始瑞士 eFUA 935 与德国 eFUA 2227 的 1 km 单元互不重叠，并集 820 km²。冻结并集规则已明确，但不是完整三国都会区。仍未解决的是 Basel-Stadt、IWB 和 EuroAirport 观测与该范围的对应关系。

sources.title: Original GHS-FUA R2019A GeoPackage archive; verified SHA-256 and cell geometry

boundary.note: Frozen union of Swiss eFUA 935 and German eFUA 2227, both referencing UC 2392. Original 1 km geometries have zero overlapping cells and union area 820 km². This scope excludes any claim to the full trinational metro; administrative evidence still requires a crosswalk.
boundary.noteZh: 冻结范围为瑞士 eFUA 935 与德国 eFUA 2227 的并集，均引用 UC 2392。原始 1 km 几何无重叠单元，并集 820 km²。该范围不声称覆盖完整三国都会区；行政统计仍须独立空间适配。

rationale.en: Estimate 70: Rhine heat and low-water observations justify a material physical-risk discount, while this inland setting is not treated like a coastal flood hotspot. The -1/decade assumption represents gradual heat and river stress; station data cannot resolve all cross-border exposure.
rationale.zh: 研究估计 70：莱茵河升温及低水位观察支持保留明显物理风险折减；内陆位置不按沿海洪灾热点处理。每十年 -1 是高温及河流压力渐增的主观假设；测站不能覆盖全部跨境暴露。

rationale.en: Estimate 80 assumes relatively low direct-war exposure under the Swiss national baseline, not zero risk. BABS explicitly retains armed conflict and nationwide supply-chain spillovers; rising UCDP interstate conflict motivates a cautious -1/decade assumption, without assigning a war probability.
rationale.zh: 研究估计 80 采用瑞士国家背景下直接战争暴露相对较低的判断，并非零风险。BABS 明确保留武装冲突及全国供应链外溢；UCDP 国家间冲突增加支持谨慎的每十年 -1 假设，不生成战争概率。

rationale.en: Estimate 80 reflects the resident survey's predominantly positive public-safety assessments and functioning feedback mechanisms. The canton sample is older and excludes much of the cross-border area; flat long-term direction assumes continuity, not automatic institutional improvement.
rationale.zh: 研究估计 80 反映居民调查中总体积极的公共安全评价及可运行的反馈机制。州级样本较旧且未覆盖大部分跨境地区；长期方向为 0，假设延续而不假定制度自动改善。

rationale.en: Estimate 75 reflects operating water and energy networks and IWB investment capacity, with a discount for unmeasured food resilience and service-area mismatch. Flat direction assumes heat-network transition broadly offsets rising supply pressure; sales volume is not reserve capacity.
rationale.zh: 研究估计 75 基于运行中的水能源网络及 IWB 投资能力，同时为未测粮食韧性与服务区差异保留折减。方向 0 假设供热转型大体抵消新增供应压力；销量不作为储备容量。

rationale.en: Estimate 80 reflects USB's advanced-provider capacity and integration of Claraspital, but insurer and cross-canton access remain important constraints. Flat direction assumes consolidation can maintain service capability; it does not assume merger plans have already improved outcomes.
rationale.zh: 研究估计 80 反映 USB 高水平医疗机构能力及 Claraspital 整合，但医保与跨州准入仍是重要约束。方向 0 假设整合有助维持能力，不把合并计划当作已改善医疗结果。

rationale.en: Estimate 60 balances life-science and ageing-research capacity against unestablished resident access to validated longevity treatments. The inspected result is preclinical, so research strength cannot support a high combined translation-and-access score. +1/decade assumes cautious maturation, not efficacy or broad coverage.
rationale.zh: 研究估计 60 平衡生命科学与衰老研究能力，以及尚未建立的居民获验证长寿疗法准入。已核查成果属临床前，研究实力不能单独支撑转化与可及合并维度的高分。每十年 +1 假设谨慎成熟，不代表疗效或普惠覆盖。

rationale.en: Estimate 70 recognises a developing nonmedical digital ecosystem through BaselTech but does not treat programme launch as realised productivity. +1/decade assumes gradual diffusion; the absence of a representative adoption series warrants a wide judgment range.
rationale.zh: 研究估计 70 认可 BaselTech 所体现的非医疗数字生态建设，不把项目启动当作生产率实现。每十年 +1 假设逐步扩散；缺少代表性采用序列，因此判断范围较宽。

rationale.en: Estimate 80 reflects established trinational airport connectivity and cross-border optionality. Passenger traffic does not establish affordable departure or residency rights for every nationality; flat direction assumes network continuity while preserving these personal-access limits.
rationale.zh: 研究估计 80 反映既有三国地区机场连接及跨境选择。客流不证明各国籍居民均能负担出行或取得居留权；方向 0 假设网络延续，同时保留个人准入限制。

summary.en: The city operates temperature/humidity monitoring and distinguishes future tropical-night projections from observations. The inspected page provides no fixed annual exposure series for the eFUA; projected frequency is not scored as current fact.
summary.zh: 城市运行温湿度监测，并区分未来热带夜预测与观察。所核查页面未提供整个 eFUA 固定年度暴露序列；预测频率不计作当前事实。

sources.title: Stadtklima Zürich
sources.period: current monitoring description; future scenarios separately identified

summary.en: The canton risk review confirms ten cross-administration risks for 2025, while BABS provides a national armed-conflict scenario. Neither supplies an observed Zurich metropolitan war probability.
summary.zh: 州风险报告确认 2025 年十项跨部门风险，BABS 提供国家武装冲突情景；两者均不提供苏黎世都市圈已观测战争概率。

sources.title: BABS KNS2025 Gefährdungsdossiers — Bewaffneter Konflikt
sources.period: 2025 scenario catalogue; not observed event frequency

summary.en: In the 2025 city resident survey, 68% feel well represented by the city executive and council. This is a municipal perception measure with subgroup differences, not objective governance performance for eFUA 1479.
summary.zh: 2025 年城市居民调查中，68% 认为市政府及议会能良好代表自己。这是含群体差异的市级感知指标，不是 eFUA 1479 的客观治理表现。

summary.en: The municipal drinking-water dataset provides individual measurements from 2023 and a 2025 CSV; metadata was updated 2026-06-09. Catalogue inspection verifies availability, not complete compliance, network resilience or water/food/energy sufficiency.
summary.zh: 市饮用水数据集提供自 2023 年起的单项测量及 2025 CSV；元数据于 2026-06-09 更新。目录核查证明可获取，不代表已完成合规、管网韧性或水粮能源充足性验证。

summary.en: USZ reports 20,767 inpatient patients in January–June 2025, 1.5% above the previous period. One tertiary provider's throughput cannot establish unmet need, waiting times or equitable access throughout the eFUA.
summary.zh: USZ 报告 2025 年 1—6 月住院患者 20,767 人，同比增长 1.5%。单一三级医疗机构业务量不能证明整个 eFUA 未满足需求、等待时间或公平准入。

sources.title: USZ mit positivem Geschäftsverlauf im ersten Halbjahr 2025

summary.en: UZH's DO-HEALTH analysis covers 777 people aged over 70 over three years, reporting changes in epigenetic clocks. Biomarker changes are clinical research observations, not demonstrated lifespan extension; enrolment years and metropolitan access are not established here.
summary.zh: UZH 的 DO-HEALTH 分析涵盖 777 名 70 岁以上人士的三年观察，报告表观遗传时钟变化。这是临床研究生物标志物观察，不是已证实延寿；此处未建立入组年份和都市圈居民准入。

summary.en: ETH recognised 46 ventures in 2025: 24 spin-offs and 22 start-ups, including some retrospective recognition. The changed definitions break simple year-on-year comparison; nonmedical, local operation and resident diffusion must be separated.
summary.zh: ETH 在 2025 年认定 46 家企业：24 家 spin-offs、22 家 start-ups，含部分追认。定义变化使简单同比无效；还须区分非医疗、本地经营与居民技术扩散。

sources.title: Mehr Neugründungen, neue Regeln, neues Förderprogramm

summary.en: Zurich Airport reports 163 destinations in 71 countries in 2025. This is realised airport connectivity, not every resident's legal right or financial capacity to relocate; airport catchment extends beyond Zurich.
summary.zh: 苏黎世机场报告 2025 年连接 71 国、163 个目的地。这是实际机场连接，不代表每位居民迁移的法律权利或财力；机场服务范围超出苏黎世。

boundaryReview.en: Candidate ID 1479 has a repository name/country match. Source-method review confirms an estimated 2015 eFUA, but this audit did not establish polygon-to-municipality, canton, hospital or airport service-area crosswalks. Name matching does not certify indicator geography.
boundaryReview.zh: 候选 ID 1479 已有仓库名称/国家匹配。来源方法确认这是估计的 2015 eFUA；本次未建立多边形与市、州、医院或机场服务范围的空间映射。名称匹配不能认证指标地理范围。

boundary.note: Direct name and country match in GHS-FUA R2019A.
boundary.noteZh: 名称与国家均直接匹配 GHS-FUA R2019A。

rationale.en: Estimate 75 reflects an inland location with documented urban-heat pressure and local monitoring; monitoring itself does not reduce physical hazard. -1/decade assumes increasing heat exposure, with uncertainty for unaggregated metropolitan flood and slope risks.
rationale.zh: 研究估计 75 反映内陆位置及已记录的城市热压力和本地监测；监测本身不降低物理危害。每十年 -1 假设热暴露增加，未聚合的都市圈洪水与坡地风险进入不确定范围。

rationale.en: Estimate 80 uses the same Swiss direct-war baseline as Basel rather than manufacturing a city-level difference. National armed-conflict scenarios and worsening global interstate trends motivate -1/decade; no local event count establishes a precise risk.
rationale.zh: 研究估计 80 与巴塞尔采用相同瑞士直接战争背景，不制造无依据的城际差异。国家武装冲突情景及全球国家间冲突趋势支持每十年 -1；没有本地事件数量能确定精确风险。

rationale.en: Estimate 85 reflects strong municipal feedback and 68% reporting good political representation, tempered by the remaining dissatisfied residents and nationality differences. Flat direction assumes institutional continuity; the 68% observation is not mechanically converted into 85.
rationale.zh: 研究估计 85 反映较强市级反馈机制与 68% 的良好政治代表感，同时考虑其余不满意居民和国籍差异。方向 0 假设制度延续；没有把 68% 机械转换成 85 分。

rationale.en: Estimate 80 is a strong-system prior supported by a public municipal water-measurement programme, not a claim that every sample or service passes. Food, energy redundancy and the wider eFUA are less directly evidenced; flat direction balances adaptation with growing demand.
rationale.zh: 研究估计 80 是有市级公开水质监测支持的较强系统先验，不声称每个样本或服务均合格。粮食、能源冗余及更大 eFUA 的直接证据较弱；方向 0 平衡适应投入与需求增长。

rationale.en: Estimate 80 reflects USZ's substantial tertiary-care throughput and treatment capacity; throughput alone cannot establish affordability, safety or unmet need. Flat direction assumes capacity broadly keeps pace with demand, with provider-to-metropolitan uncertainty retained.
rationale.zh: 研究估计 80 反映 USZ 较大的三级医疗业务量和治疗能力；业务量本身不能证明可负担、安全或未满足需求。方向 0 假设容量大体跟上需求，保留单院到都市圈的外推不确定性。

rationale.en: Estimate 60 recognises DO-HEALTH human research while retaining a substantial access constraint. Changes in epigenetic clocks are not validated lifespan gains, and a strong research platform does not establish broadly accessible longevity treatment. +1/decade assumes slow translation and access development, not guaranteed benefit.
rationale.zh: 研究估计 60 认可 DO-HEALTH 人体研究，同时保留明显准入约束。表观遗传时钟变化不等于已验证延寿，强研究平台也不证明长寿治疗广泛可及。每十年 +1 假设转化与可及缓慢发展，不保证获益。

rationale.en: Estimate 85 reflects active ETH-linked technology formation, with 24 spin-offs and 22 start-ups recognised in 2025. Definition changes, medical overlap and resident diffusion limit the inference; +1/decade assumes continued nonmedical transfer rather than extrapolating venture counts.
rationale.zh: 研究估计 85 反映活跃的 ETH 技术创业，2025 年认定 24 家 spin-offs 和 22 家 start-ups。定义变化、医疗重叠及居民扩散限制推断；每十年 +1 假设非医疗转移持续，不外推企业数量。

rationale.en: Estimate 85 reflects a hub serving 163 destinations in 71 countries and its ground links. The broad airport catchment is not the city population and individual legal/financial exit options vary; flat direction assumes maintained connectivity rather than perpetual route growth.
rationale.zh: 研究估计 85 反映连接 71 国 163 目的地及地面接驳的枢纽。机场广域服务人口不等于城市居民且法律/财务退出选择各异；方向 0 假设维持连接，不假定航线永远增长。

summary.en: Toronto identifies a warmer, wetter and less predictable climate and publishes a 2025 risk assessment. City scenarios and qualitative hazards require population-weighted eFUA extraction before use; no tail threshold is certified.
summary.zh: 多伦多发布 2025 年风险评估，指出气候更热、更湿且更难预测。市级情景与定性危害需按 eFUA 人口加权提取后才能入模，尚不能认证尾部风险门槛。

summary.en: The report explicitly warns that annual Major Crime Indicator counts and the Public Safety Data Portal are not comparable because extraction methods differ. No series was spliced or converted to a conflict score; wider strategic exposure remains unmeasured.
summary.zh: 报告明确警告年度主要犯罪统计与公开安全数据门户因提取方式不同而不可比较。未拼接时间序列或换算冲突分数；更广泛的战略风险仍未测量。

sources.title: 2024 Toronto Police Service Chief’s Annual Report

summary.en: The city publishes 2025 financial statements and annual reporting. Availability supports fiscal accountability review but does not itself establish adaptive capacity, cohesion or disaster recovery performance; no financial ratio was extracted.
summary.zh: 市府公开 2025 年财务报表与年度报告，可支持财政问责审核；公开报告本身不能证明适应能力、凝聚力或灾后恢复绩效，未提取财务比率。

summary.en: The producer lists 2025 testing, adverse-result, system-compliance and lead-mitigation reports. This establishes a local water evidence trail, not a full eFUA extraction or food/energy supply assessment.
summary.zh: 生产方列出 2025 年检测、异常结果、系统合规及减铅报告，形成当地用水证据路径；尚未完成 eFUA 提取或食品、能源供应评估。

summary.en: Toronto Public Health provides geographic and sociodemographic dashboards and warns of inequities. Underlying healthcare-access values, sample uncertainty and alignment to the larger eFUA were not extracted; the 2023 profile is not relabelled 2026.
summary.zh: 多伦多公共卫生部门提供地域与社会人口分组仪表板，并明确健康不平等。未提取就医可及性原值、抽样不确定性或与更大 eFUA 的对应关系；不将 2023 年概况改称 2026 年数据。

summary.en: Baycrest describes brain-health trials with ethics review and eligibility assessment. This confirms a local research pathway but provides neither deduplicated trial-phase counts nor population access or proven general longevity benefit.
summary.zh: Baycrest 描述经伦理审查和资格筛选的脑健康试验，证明存在本地研究路径；未提供按阶段去重的试验数量、人口可及性或已证实的普遍延寿效益。

sources.title: Anne & Allan Bank Centre for Clinical Research Trials

summary.en: The city employment survey provides sector and location counts. Municipality, downtown and employment-area tables must not be treated as eFUA technology employment; research output and household digital diffusion remain separate missing constructs.
summary.zh: 市级就业调查提供行业与地点统计；市界、市中心及就业区表格不能作为 eFUA 科技就业数据，科研产出与家庭数字普及仍是独立缺口。

summary.en: TTC reports roughly 193 million bus riders over 143.5 million kilometres in 2025 and 77% bus on-time performance in April 2026. Operator metrics are useful context but not all-mode metro redundancy, legal mobility or asset portability.
summary.zh: TTC 报告 2025 年公交约 1.93 亿人次、1.435 亿公里，2026 年 4 月公交准点率 77%。运营商指标可作背景，不能代表全都市圈多方式冗余、法律迁移能力或资产可携性。

boundaryReview.en: The existing candidate records a direct name/country match. This review did not spatially reconcile municipal, operator or provincial observations with the 2015 GHS-FUA polygon; local observations are not yet qualified as eFUA scoring inputs.
boundaryReview.zh: 既有候选数据记录名称与国家直接匹配。本次未将市界、运营商或省级观测与 2015 年 GHS-FUA 多边形进行空间对齐；当地观测尚未具备作为 eFUA 评分输入的资格。

boundary.note: Direct name and country match in GHS-FUA R2019A.
boundary.noteZh: 名称与国家均直接匹配 GHS-FUA R2019A。

rationale.en: Research estimate 70/100 (judgment half-width ±15); subjective long-run direction -2/decade. Climate assessment indicates warmer and wetter conditions, but organized adaptation supports above-middle resilience; decline assumes increasing heat and flood pressure.
rationale.zh: 研究估计 70/100（判断半宽 ±15）；主观长期方向每十年 -2 分。气候评估显示更热更湿，有组织适应支持中上韧性；下降假设高温与洪水压力持续增加。

rationale.en: Research estimate 80/100 (judgment half-width ±18); subjective long-run direction -1/decade. Police reporting and Canadian national background support a strong security judgment; incompatible crime series and unmeasured strategic risks preclude greater precision or a zero-risk claim.
rationale.zh: 研究估计 80/100（判断半宽 ±18）；主观长期方向每十年 -1 分。警方报告及加拿大国家背景支持较强安全判断；犯罪序列不兼容且战略风险未测量，不能进一步精确化或宣称零风险。

rationale.en: Research estimate 80/100 (judgment half-width ±15); subjective long-run direction +0/decade. Published financial reporting and climate assessment suggest strong institutional capacity; without extracted recovery or cohesion outcomes, the long-term direction remains neutral.
rationale.zh: 研究估计 80/100（判断半宽 ±15）；主观长期方向每十年 +0 分。公开财务报告及气候评估体现较强制度能力；未提取恢复或凝聚力结果，长期方向采用中性假设。

rationale.en: Research estimate 80/100 (judgment half-width ±15); subjective long-run direction -1/decade. Systematic water testing and compliance reporting support strong essential-service capacity; the estimate discounts unmeasured food and energy redundancy and assumes modest climate pressure.
rationale.zh: 研究估计 80/100（判断半宽 ±15）；主观长期方向每十年 -1 分。系统水质检测与合规报告支持较强基本服务能力；估计考虑未测量的食品能源冗余缺口，并假设轻微气候压力。

rationale.en: Research estimate 75/100 (judgment half-width ±18); subjective long-run direction +1/decade. Population-health monitoring and local clinical institutions support substantial care capacity; documented inequality and unextracted access measures constrain the level, with gradual improvement assumed.
rationale.zh: 研究估计 75/100（判断半宽 ±18）；主观长期方向每十年 +1 分。人口健康监测及当地临床机构支持较强医疗能力；已记录不平等及未提取的可及性指标限制分数，假设逐步改善。

rationale.en: Research estimate 60/100 (judgment half-width ±18); subjective long-run direction +2/decade. Baycrest provides an established brain-health research pathway, supporting readiness with material gaps. Trial translation does not establish broadly accessible validated regenerative or longevity interventions; growth assumes both evidence and resident access improve.
rationale.zh: 研究估计 60/100（判断半宽 ±18）；主观长期方向每十年 +2 分。Baycrest 提供已有脑健康科研路径，支持具备能力但仍有明显短板的准备度。试验转化不等于居民广泛可及经验证再生或长寿干预；增长假设证据和居民可及性同时改善。

rationale.en: Research estimate 80/100 (judgment half-width ±15); subjective long-run direction +1/decade. The employment survey and research institutions support a strong knowledge economy; municipal boundaries and incomplete digital-diffusion measures justify restrained positive direction.
rationale.zh: 研究估计 80/100（判断半宽 ±15）；主观长期方向每十年 +1 分。就业调查与科研机构支持较强知识经济；市级边界及不完整的数字普及测量使正向幅度保持克制。

rationale.en: Research estimate 75/100 (judgment half-width ±15); subjective long-run direction +1/decade. Observed TTC service volumes and punctuality show functioning transport with room to improve; a modest positive direction concerns service delivery, not unverified legal mobility rights.
rationale.zh: 研究估计 75/100（判断半宽 ±15）；主观长期方向每十年 +1 分。TTC 服务量和准点率观测体现正常运行且仍可改善的交通；小幅正向针对服务交付，不代表未核实的法律迁移权利。

summary.en: The plan projects up to 46 days above 90°F annually in the 2070s versus a historical 10. This is a municipal scenario, not a current eFUA heat observation; humidity, flooding and geophysical inputs are incomplete.
summary.zh: 计划预计 2070 年代每年超过 90°F 的天数可达 46 天，历史基准为 10 天。这是市级情景预测，非当前 eFUA 高温观测；湿度、洪水和地质灾害输入仍不完整。

summary.en: Police publish Part 1 crime and shooting reports for this window. The landing page establishes availability, not extracted counts. Recorded city crime does not measure regional conflict or strategic exposure.
summary.zh: 警方公开该时段的一级犯罪与枪击报告。已核查发布入口，未提取数量；市内报案犯罪不能代表地区冲突或战略风险。

summary.en: The city documents a dedicated climate resilience office created in August 2024 and completed coastal plans for its 47-mile coastline. Institutional arrangements and plans do not establish delivery, social cohesion or recovery outcomes.
summary.zh: 市府记录 2024 年 8 月设立气候韧性办公室，并为 47 英里海岸线完成规划；机构与计划不能证明实施成效、社会凝聚力或恢复能力。

summary.en: Boston sampled 33 higher-risk homes: lead 90th percentile 22.5 ppb, above the stated 15 ppb action level; 4 samples exceeded it. Targeted premise plumbing results must not be generalized to all homes or contradicted by upstream compliance claims. Food and energy resilience remain unmeasured.
summary.zh: 波士顿在 33 户较高风险住宅抽检：铅第 90 百分位为 22.5 ppb，高于报告列示的 15 ppb 行动值，4 份样本超标。针对住宅管道的结果不能外推所有住户，也不能被上游供水达标声明抵消；食品和能源韧性未测量。

sources.title: 2025 Annual Water Quality Test Results - Full Service

summary.en: The 2025 assessment and improvement plan explicitly retain access to care, housing, food and economic opportunity as priorities. This supports an access-gap review, not a complete normalized metro healthcare score; facility and population denominators were not extracted.
summary.zh: 2025 年评估与改善计划仍将就医、住房、食品和经济机会列为重点，可支持可及性缺口审核；尚未提取设施和人口分母，不能形成完整都市圈医疗评分。

summary.en: Mass General documents Alzheimer treatment pathways and research recruitment. A provider programme is not a deduplicated geroscience trial inventory, a lifespan benefit, or evidence that all residents can afford treatment.
summary.zh: 麻省总医院记录阿尔茨海默病治疗路径及研究招募；单一机构项目不等于去重后的老龄科研试验清单、延寿获益或全体居民可负担治疗的证据。

summary.en: The city publishes a life-sciences industry snapshot. Its undated employment and institution totals were not adopted as 2026 observations; a reproducible industry classification, geographic scope and digital diffusion data are absent.
summary.zh: 市府提供生命科学行业概况，但就业与机构总量无明确观测日期，未作为 2026 年观测采用；仍缺可复现的行业分类、地理范围及数字技术普及数据。

summary.en: The MBTA performance office explains changed reliability measures and a Fall 2023 comparison. This is direct methodology evidence; the MBTA policy page itself was robots-blocked. No comparable current network redundancy or legal mobility measure was extracted.
summary.zh: MBTA 绩效办公室说明可靠性指标调整及 2023 年秋季对照，这是生产方方法证据；MBTA 政策页面本身被 robots 阻止读取。未提取可比的当前网络冗余或法律迁移能力指标。

sources.title: The MBTA’s 2024 Service Delivery Policy: Changing how Success is Measured

boundaryReview.en: The existing candidate records a direct name/country match. This review did not spatially reconcile municipal, operator or provincial observations with the 2015 GHS-FUA polygon; local observations are not yet qualified as eFUA scoring inputs.
boundaryReview.zh: 既有候选数据记录名称与国家直接匹配。本次未将市界、运营商或省级观测与 2015 年 GHS-FUA 多边形进行空间对齐；当地观测尚未具备作为 eFUA 评分输入的资格。

boundary.note: Direct name and country match in GHS-FUA R2019A.
boundary.noteZh: 名称与国家均直接匹配 GHS-FUA R2019A。

rationale.en: Research estimate 65/100 (judgment half-width ±15); subjective long-run direction -2/decade. Coastal exposure and the city heat scenario constrain otherwise substantial adaptation capacity; the negative direction assumes warming outpaces some protection.
rationale.zh: 研究估计 65/100（判断半宽 ±15）；主观长期方向每十年 -2 分。海岸暴露及市级高温情景限制较强的适应能力；负向假设升温仍会超过部分防护进展。

rationale.en: Research estimate 75/100 (judgment half-width ±18); subjective long-run direction -1/decade. A working police reporting system supports a relatively strong security judgment, but is not proof of low strategic exposure; slight deterioration allows for unmeasured geopolitical risk.
rationale.zh: 研究估计 75/100（判断半宽 ±18）；主观长期方向每十年 -1 分。正常运行的警方报告体系支持较强安全判断，但不能证明战略暴露低；小幅负向为未量化地缘风险预留空间。

rationale.en: Research estimate 80/100 (judgment half-width ±15); subjective long-run direction +1/decade. A dedicated resilience office and coastal planning suggest strong administrative capacity; modest improvement assumes implementation, with cohesion and recovery still uncertain.
rationale.zh: 研究估计 80/100（判断半宽 ±15）；主观长期方向每十年 +1 分。专设韧性办公室及海岸规划体现较强行政能力；小幅改善以落实为前提，社会凝聚与恢复成效仍不确定。

rationale.en: Research estimate 75/100 (judgment half-width ±15); subjective long-run direction -1/decade. Regional water infrastructure is strong, while the targeted lead exceedance shows important last-mile weakness; climate and ageing assets justify a mildly adverse direction.
rationale.zh: 研究估计 75/100（判断半宽 ±15）；主观长期方向每十年 -1 分。区域水务基础设施较强，但定向抽检铅超行动值暴露末端短板；气候及设施老化支持轻微负向假设。

rationale.en: Research estimate 85/100 (judgment half-width ±15); subjective long-run direction +1/decade. Specialist institutions and organized health assessment support high capacity, tempered by the local access-to-care priority; gradual improvement assumes better access rather than universal coverage today.
rationale.zh: 研究估计 85/100（判断半宽 ±15）；主观长期方向每十年 +1 分。专科机构和系统健康评估支持较高医疗能力，但当地仍将就医可及性列为重点；缓慢改善假设可及性提高，不声称目前全面覆盖。

rationale.en: Research estimate 70/100 (judgment half-width ±18); subjective long-run direction +2/decade. Alzheimer treatment pathways and concentrated clinical research support substantial translational readiness. Broad resident access to validated regenerative or longevity interventions is not established, so readiness falls below strong-and-redundant capacity; growth assumes cautious evidence-based adoption.
rationale.zh: 研究估计 70/100（判断半宽 ±18）；主观长期方向每十年 +2 分。阿尔茨海默病治疗路径与集中临床研究支持较强转化准备度，但尚未证明普通居民广泛可及经验证的再生或长寿干预，因此不足以评为强大且有冗余；增长假设谨慎的循证采用。

rationale.en: Research estimate 85/100 (judgment half-width ±15); subjective long-run direction +1/decade. The documented life-sciences and research ecosystem supports a strong knowledge-capacity judgment; undated industry totals widen uncertainty and justify only modest growth.
rationale.zh: 研究估计 85/100（判断半宽 ±15）；主观长期方向每十年 +1 分。已记录的生命科学及科研生态支持较强知识能力判断；行业总量日期不明扩大不确定性，因此仅假设温和增长。

rationale.en: Research estimate 80/100 (judgment half-width ±18); subjective long-run direction +0/decade. Multiple transit service types and formal reliability evaluation support substantial transport options; stable direction avoids assuming improvements in unmeasured residence or asset-transfer rights.
rationale.zh: 研究估计 80/100（判断半宽 ±18）；主观长期方向每十年 +0 分。多种公共交通服务及正式可靠性评估支持较丰富出行选择；法律居留和资产转移未测量，因此采用稳定方向。

summary.en: The city publishes a hazards and climate resilience plan covering buildings, infrastructure and communities. San Francisco city exposure cannot stand for the unresolved San Jose-named Bay Area eFUA; no polygon-weighted hazard observation was extracted.
summary.zh: 市府发布覆盖建筑、基础设施和社区的灾害与气候韧性计划。旧金山市暴露不能代表尚未核清的 San Jose 命名湾区 eFUA；未提取按多边形加权的灾害观测。

summary.en: Police identify the series as preliminary crime warehouse data with a fixed weekly window. It covers San Francisco reporting, not the Bay Area or organized-conflict exposure; no absence-of-conflict conclusion follows.
summary.zh: 警方标明这是固定周窗口的初步犯罪数据库统计，覆盖旧金山报案而非整个湾区或有组织冲突暴露；不能据此推断不存在冲突。

sources.title: San Francisco Police Department Crime Trends - May 7 2025

summary.en: The civilian oversight report records 899 complaints and 938 cases closed in 2025. These are administrative flows, not a rights-violation prevalence estimate; reporting access and case timing prevent a simple good/bad score.
summary.zh: 民间监督机构年报记录 2025 年 899 宗投诉、938 宗结案。这是行政流量而非权利侵害发生率，报案可及性与跨期结案使其不能直接换算好坏分数。

sources.title: San Francisco Department of Police Accountability — 2025 Annual Report

summary.en: SFPUC reports over 95,000 tests and compliance with federal/state water standards in 2025. Nondetection is method-dependent, not proof of zero contaminant; the SFPUC service area does not cover every Bay Area resident or energy/food system.
summary.zh: SFPUC 报告 2025 年超过 95,000 次检测并符合州及联邦供水标准。未检出取决于检测方法，不能证明污染物为零；其供区不覆盖全部湾区居民或能源、食品系统。

sources.title: SFPUC Releases Annual Water Quality Report, Reflecting a Century of Investment in Safe Drinking Water

summary.en: The data-producing health partnership publishes a 2025 CHNA. The page also describes 2022 access, behavioral-health and economic priorities; older priorities are not relabelled as new findings. A complete metro access/quality extraction is unavailable here.
summary.zh: 健康评估生产方公开 2025 年 CHNA；同页也描述 2022 年就医、行为健康与经济重点，不将旧结论当作新发现。本次未取得完整都市圈医疗可及性与质量提取结果。

summary.en: Stanford supplies condition, NCT ID, recruitment and age filters. A provider directory is a discovery route, not a reconciled Bay Area geroscience registry; trial maturity, outcomes and affordability were not established.
summary.zh: 斯坦福提供疾病、NCT 编号、招募状态和年龄筛选。机构目录只是发现入口，不是已对齐的湾区老龄科研注册表；尚未确认试验成熟度、结局与可负担性。

summary.en: The official packet reports 107,100 information-sector jobs for San Francisco–San Mateo in August 2025. The industry is not equivalent to all technology and the metro division excludes much of the Bay Area; no eFUA score is calculated.
summary.zh: 官方材料列示 2025 年 8 月旧金山—圣马特奥信息行业就业 107,100 人。该行业不等于全部科技行业，统计分区也未覆盖湾区大部；未计算 eFUA 分数。

summary.en: BART reports fare-gate installation at all 50 stations and service coordination with partner agencies. Operator self-report describes implementation but not complete disruption redundancy, legal mobility or asset portability; the Bay Area boundary is unresolved.
summary.zh: BART 报告全部 50 站安装新闸机并与其他机构协调服务。运营商自报说明实施情况，不等于完整中断冗余、法律迁移能力或资产可携性评估；湾区边界仍未解决。

sources.title: Top accomplishments of 2025 usher in the New BART

boundaryReview.en: The candidate uses eFUA 1255, source name San Jose, urban-centre IDs 10 and 13. No geometry overlay verifies that the public San Francisco Bay Area alias matches this footprint; municipal and operator statistics cannot certify it.
boundaryReview.zh: 候选数据使用 eFUA 1255、来源名称 San Jose、城市中心 ID 10 和 13。尚无几何叠置验证公众所称旧金山湾区与该范围一致；市级及运营商统计不能认证此别名。

boundary.note: The product names this Bay Area eFUA after San Jose; the public alias needs a documented spatial review.
boundary.noteZh: 该产品以 San Jose 命名此湾区 eFUA；公开别名仍需完成空间审核。

rationale.en: Research estimate 50/100 (judgment half-width ±18); subjective long-run direction -2/decade. Seismic and climate hazards impose material constraints despite municipal adaptation planning; negative direction assumes rising climate burdens, with Bay Area geography unresolved.
rationale.zh: 研究估计 50/100（判断半宽 ±18）；主观长期方向每十年 -2 分。地震与气候灾害带来明显约束，市级适应规划只能部分抵消；负向假设气候负担上升，湾区范围仍未对齐。

rationale.en: Research estimate 75/100 (judgment half-width ±18); subjective long-run direction -1/decade. Police reporting provides a local accountability signal but no complete conflict assessment; relatively strong security is a regional-background judgment with a cautious adverse drift.
rationale.zh: 研究估计 75/100（判断半宽 ±18）；主观长期方向每十年 -1 分。警方报告提供本地问责信号，但并非完整冲突评估；较强安全是结合地区背景的研究判断，并采取谨慎负向变化。

rationale.en: Research estimate 75/100 (judgment half-width ±15); subjective long-run direction +0/decade. Civilian oversight and published complaint processing indicate institutional capacity; complaints are not prevalence rates, and unchanged direction reflects unresolved regional coordination.
rationale.zh: 研究估计 75/100（判断半宽 ±15）；主观长期方向每十年 +0 分。民间监督及公开投诉处理体现制度能力；投诉数不等于侵害率，跨区域协调未明，因此采用稳定方向。

rationale.en: Research estimate 70/100 (judgment half-width ±15); subjective long-run direction -1/decade. SFPUC testing and regulatory compliance support strong service capacity, with climate and service-area gaps limiting resilience; mild decline assumes pressure on water and ageing networks.
rationale.zh: 研究估计 70/100（判断半宽 ±15）；主观长期方向每十年 -1 分。SFPUC 检测和监管合规支持较强服务能力，气候及供区缺口限制韧性；小幅下降假设供水与老化网络压力持续。

rationale.en: Research estimate 85/100 (judgment half-width ±18); subjective long-run direction +1/decade. Major local clinical institutions and systematic needs assessment support specialist strength, but access gaps constrain the judgment; improvement assumes access catches up gradually.
rationale.zh: 研究估计 85/100（判断半宽 ±18）；主观长期方向每十年 +1 分。当地重要临床机构及系统需求评估支持专科优势，但可及性缺口限制判断；改善假设就医机会逐步追上能力。

rationale.en: Research estimate 75/100 (judgment half-width ±18); subjective long-run direction +2/decade. Stanford trial infrastructure and regional research support substantial translational readiness, but neither broad affordable access nor validated general longevity interventions are established. The level remains below strong-and-redundant capacity; growth assumes evidence matures and access improves.
rationale.zh: 研究估计 75/100（判断半宽 ±18）；主观长期方向每十年 +2 分。斯坦福试验基础设施及区域研究支持较强转化准备度，但尚未证明广泛可负担接入或经验证的普遍长寿干预，故仍低于强大且有冗余水平；增长假设证据成熟且可及性改善。

rationale.en: Research estimate 90/100 (judgment half-width ±15); subjective long-run direction +1/decade. The observed SF–San Mateo information employment base supports high industry concentration; boundary mismatch and the difference between information and all technology limit certainty and growth.
rationale.zh: 研究估计 90/100（判断半宽 ±15）；主观长期方向每十年 +1 分。SF—圣马特奥观测到的信息行业就业基础支持高度产业集聚；边界不匹配且信息行业不等于全部科技，限制确定性和增长幅度。

rationale.en: Research estimate 80/100 (judgment half-width ±18); subjective long-run direction +0/decade. BART and partner-agency coordination support diverse regional transport options; geography, disruption alternatives and legal mobility are incomplete, so the assumed direction is flat.
rationale.zh: 研究估计 80/100（判断半宽 ±18）；主观长期方向每十年 +0 分。BART 及合作机构协调支持多样区域交通选择；地理范围、中断替代与法律迁移能力不完整，因此假设方向持平。

summary.en: The July 2024 local climate review identifies heat, flooding and drought and distinguishes defence planning dates from observed hazards. It does not provide a single audited eFUA exposure measure; 2040/2050 works deadlines are plans, not current protection outcomes.
summary.zh: 2024 年 7 月本地气候审查识别高温、洪水和干旱，并区分防御规划日期与已发生危害。它不提供统一核准的 eFUA 暴露指标；2040/2050 工程期限是计划，不是当前防护结果。

summary.en: London Risk Register searches located the official v14 document, but full retrieval returned 403. UCDP's available annual/monthly data were inspected at catalogue level only; no London spatial conflict join or comparable military-exposure measure was established.
summary.zh: 检索找到官方 London Risk Register v14，但全文访问返回 403。UCDP 年度/月度数据仅核查到目录；未建立伦敦冲突空间连接或可比军事暴露指标。

summary.en: The GLA's PAS summary reports 74% trusting the MPS in April 2025 and 68% feeling safe after dark in Q3 2025/26, versus 58% among women. These are survey perceptions, not recorded conflict or universal safety; MOPAC is their common upstream.
summary.zh: GLA 的 PAS 摘要报告 2025 年 4 月 74% 信任伦敦警察；2025/26 第三季度 68% 夜间独行感到安全，女性为 58%。这是调查感知，不是冲突记录或人人安全；共同上游为 MOPAC。

summary.en: Thames Water reports a three-year rolling leakage average of 584 Ml/day at half-year 2025/26. This is a regional operator metric, not Greater London alone; water quality, outages and affordability require separate indicators and food/energy remain uncovered.
summary.zh: Thames Water 在 2025/26 半年报报告三年滚动平均漏损 584 百万升/日。这是区域运营者指标，不仅覆盖大伦敦；水质、停供与可负担性需独立指标，粮食和能源仍无对应观察。

sources.period: half-year 2025/26; leakage is three-year rolling average

summary.en: GLA's health chapter separates care-system indicators and borough inequalities from overall life expectancy, linking NHS vaccination and OHID outcomes. Direct NHS RTT retrieval was unavailable; no complete eFUA care access, quality and affordability measure was established.
summary.zh: GLA 健康章节区分医疗系统指标、行政区不平等与总体寿命，并链接 NHS 疫苗及 OHID 结果。NHS RTT 原文访问未成功；未建立整个 eFUA 医疗可及、质量和可负担性完整指标。

summary.en: UCL announced preparations for a first-in-human immune-rejuvenation Phase 1 trial on 2026-06-18. The announcement describes safety/biological-activity aims, not proven clinical benefit; trial initiation, results and routine resident access were not established.
summary.zh: UCL 于 2026-06-18 公告筹备首次人体免疫年轻化一期试验。目标是安全性/生物活性，不是已证明临床获益；此处未确认试验已启动、结果或居民常规准入。

sources.title: New trial aims to extend immune system lifespan

summary.en: BDUK publishes a January 2025 London premises-level package distinguishing existing gigabit connections from commercial and public delivery plans. The catalogue was inspected, not aggregated; planned infrastructure and actual innovation diffusion cannot be conflated.
summary.zh: BDUK 发布 2025 年 1 月伦敦场所级数据，区分已有千兆连接、商业及公共交付计划。已核查目录但未聚合；规划基础设施不能混同实际创新扩散。

sources.title: January 2025 OMR and premises in BDUK plans

summary.en: Heathrow's 2025 results report over 84.5 million passengers. This verifies one airport's throughput, not all London airports or personal exit rights; expansion forecasts and expected 2026 traffic are excluded.
summary.zh: 希思罗 2025 业绩公告报告超过 8,450 万旅客。它核实单一机场流量，不代表全部伦敦机场或个人退出权利；不采用扩建预测和 2026 预期流量。

sources.title: Heathrow results for year ended 31 Dec 2025

boundaryReview.en: Repository ID 5288 is name-matched to London; this review finds mismatched footprints across GLA boroughs, MPS/PAS, regional water supply and individual airports. No population-weighted or polygon crosswalk to the frozen 2015 eFUA was established.
boundaryReview.zh: 仓库 ID 5288 已按名称匹配伦敦；本次发现 GLA 行政区、MPS/PAS、区域供水及单机场范围不同。未建立到冻结 2015 eFUA 的人口加权或多边形映射。

boundary.note: Direct name and country match in GHS-FUA R2019A.
boundary.noteZh: 名称与国家均直接匹配 GHS-FUA R2019A。

rationale.en: Estimate 60 reflects combined heat, flood and drought pressures identified in the local review. Existing flood protection matters, but future upgrade deadlines are not completed defences; -2/decade assumes physical pressure rises faster than baseline protection without further adaptation.
rationale.zh: 研究估计 60 反映本地审查识别的高温、洪水和干旱复合压力。既有防洪有意义，但未来升级期限不是已建成防御；每十年 -2 假设若无更多适应，物理压力增长快于基线保护。

rationale.en: Estimate 70 is a cautious national/geopolitical prior for a major internationally connected capital, not a measured London conflict rate. The inaccessible local risk register widens uncertainty; UCDP's interstate trend motivates -1/decade rather than a quantified escalation probability.
rationale.zh: 研究估计 70 是对高度国际连接首都的谨慎国家/地缘先验，不是伦敦实测冲突率。本地风险档案访问受限扩大不确定范围；UCDP 国家间趋势支持每十年 -1，而非量化升级概率。

rationale.en: Estimate 70 balances 74% reported police trust with pronounced subgroup and borough safety differences. Survey commissioning changes and self-report bias limit precision; flat direction assumes neither automatic recovery nor continued institutional decline.
rationale.zh: 研究估计 70 平衡 74% 的警察信任与明显群体、行政区安全差异。调查机制变化与自报偏差限制精度；方向 0 不假定自动恢复或制度持续衰退。

rationale.en: Estimate 55 reflects material water-service and investment constraints, including Thames Water's large leakage burden and adverse performance indicators. The operator extends beyond London and food/energy are incompletely observed; flat direction assumes remediation offsets pressure without banking announced improvements.
rationale.zh: 研究估计 55 反映明显供水与投资约束，包括 Thames Water 较大漏损及不佳绩效信号。运营范围超出伦敦，粮食能源观察不完整；方向 0 假设整改抵消压力，不提前兑现公告改善。

rationale.en: Estimate 70 recognises a substantial care system but discounts documented borough inequalities and incomplete access evidence. Overall longevity is not a substitute for care delivery; flat direction assumes capability is maintained under demand pressure, not that waiting-time constraints disappear.
rationale.zh: 研究估计 70 认可较大医疗系统，同时为已记载行政区不平等与准入证据不足折减。总体寿命不替代医疗交付；方向 0 假设需求压力下维持能力，不假定等待约束消失。

rationale.en: Estimate 60 recognises UCL’s translational setting and planned immune-rejuvenation Phase 1 programme, but balances them against unestablished routine resident access. Trial announcements and ILAP support are neither proven benefit nor broad coverage; current evidence does not justify a premium over the other European research centres. +1/decade assumes gradual maturation.
rationale.zh: 研究估计 60 认可 UCL 转化环境及计划中的免疫年轻化一期项目，同时考虑居民常规准入尚未建立。试验公告与 ILAP 支持不等于已证实获益或普惠覆盖；现有证据不足以支持高于其他欧洲研究中心的溢价。每十年 +1 假设逐步成熟。

rationale.en: Estimate 80 reflects an advanced urban digital setting and premises-level infrastructure planning, while incomplete local uptake evidence prevents a near-ceiling judgment. +1/decade assumes continued diffusion of nonmedical AI and connectivity, not guaranteed productivity from announced rollout.
rationale.zh: 研究估计 80 反映较成熟城市数字环境与场所级基础设施规划；本地采用证据不完整，因此不接近上限。每十年 +1 假设非医疗 AI 与连接继续扩散，不把部署公告当作保证生产率。

rationale.en: Estimate 85 reflects Heathrow's demonstrated hub scale and international connections, not passenger volume as a direct score formula. Personal immigration status, cost and disruption remain constraints; flat direction excludes planned expansion from the baseline.
rationale.zh: 研究估计 85 反映希思罗已实现的枢纽规模与国际连接，不以客流作为直接评分公式。个人移民身份、费用及中断仍构成约束；方向 0 不把规划扩建计入基线。

summary.en: The municipality identifies extreme heat, drought, heavy-rain flooding and flood risk and publishes 2025 adaptation progress. Policy and progress documentation do not quantify present eFUA hazard exposure or guarantee future protection.
summary.zh: 市政府识别极端高温、干旱、强降雨内涝与洪灾风险并公开 2025 适应进展。政策与进度文档不量化当前 eFUA 暴露，也不保证未来防护。

summary.en: The Amsterdam-Amstelland regional risk profile covers 2025–2028 and was considered by council on 2025-04-02. This is regional preparedness context, not observed metropolitan warfare frequency or a calibrated long-term war probability.
summary.zh: Amsterdam-Amstelland 区域风险档案覆盖 2025—2028，市议会于 2025-04-02 审议。它是区域备灾背景，不是都市圈战争发生率或校准的长期战争概率。

summary.en: O&S reports the self-reported victimisation index in Oost rising from 98 in 2024 to 107 in 2025. This is a district survey index, not raw crimes or a city governance score; reported victimisation and police registrations must remain distinct.
summary.zh: O&S 报告 Oost 区自报受害指数从 2024 年 98 升至 2025 年 107。这是区级调查指数，不是犯罪件数或城市治理分数；自报受害与警方登记须区分。

sources.title: Openbare orde en veiligheid in cijfers 2026

summary.en: Leiduin's 2025 regulatory table reports four chlorate measurements above the then 1 µg/L standard and notes notification to the inspectorate; it explicitly notes a 250 µg/L standard from 2026. One production site and changing standards cannot establish whole-network compliance or resilience.
summary.zh: Leiduin 2025 法定化验表报告四次氯酸盐测量超过当时 1 µg/L 标准并通知监管机构；表内明确 2026 起标准为 250 µg/L。单一生产点与标准变化不能证明整个管网合规或韧性。

summary.en: GGD's 2024 adult/older-resident monitor reports municipal health and subgroup differences, published June 2025. Population health surveillance is not itself a complete health-care delivery/access measure; eFUA coverage and unmet-care fields were not established.
summary.zh: GGD 的 2024 成年/老年居民监测于 2025 年 6 月公布，按群体呈现市级健康差异。人群健康监测本身不等于完整医疗交付/准入指标；未建立 eFUA 覆盖与未满足医疗需求字段。

summary.en: Amsterdam UMC's 2026-10-01 publication record reports NCT05506488: 31 participants in a Phase 2 randomised MASH senolytic trial; the primary fibrosis endpoint was 47% versus 7%, with adverse events 82% versus 43%. This disease-specific small trial is not general lifespan extension or routine resident access.
summary.zh: Amsterdam UMC 的 2026-10-01 论文记录报告 NCT05506488：31 人 MASH 衰老细胞清除二期随机试验；主要纤维化终点为 47% 对 7%，不良事件 82% 对 43%。小样本特定疾病试验不是普遍延寿或居民常规准入。

sources.title: Senolytics dasatinib and quercetin in MASH — randomized controlled trial
sources.period: published 2026-10-01; three 7-week treatment cycles; enrolment dates not established

summary.en: The December 2025 municipal digital monitor examines Amsterdam/Weesp residents' devices, skills and barriers. This supplies a local diffusion source, but no extracted comparable nonmedical innovation/productivity measure; cybercrime observations belong in ISR, not a second TEC penalty.
summary.zh: 2025 年 12 月市级数字监测研究 Amsterdam/Weesp 居民设备、技能和障碍。它提供本地扩散来源，但未提取可比非医疗创新/生产率指标；网络犯罪观察归 ISR，不再作为 TEC 重复扣分。

sources.title: Monitor Amsterdammers Digitaal 2025
sources.period: published 2025-12; survey fieldwork dates not established

summary.en: Schiphol reports 68.8 million passengers and 300 worldwide destinations in 2025, including 124 intercontinental. Airport metrics do not establish nationality-specific relocation rights, asset portability or emergency departure options.
summary.zh: Schiphol 报告 2025 年旅客 6,880 万、全球目的地 300 个（洲际 124 个）。机场指标不证明按国籍区分的迁居权、资产可携带性或紧急撤离选择。

sources.title: Schiphol in 2025: stillere vliegtuigen, meer tevreden reizigers en solide financiële resultaten

boundaryReview.en: Repository ID 1427 is name-matched. Municipality including Weesp, Amsterdam-Amstelland safety region, Leiduin production supply and Schiphol catchment are different geographies; their observations were not spatially reconciled to the frozen 2015 eFUA.
boundaryReview.zh: 仓库 ID 1427 已名称匹配。含 Weesp 的市域、Amsterdam-Amstelland 安全区、Leiduin 供水范围与 Schiphol 服务区域并非同一地理单位；本次未将观察空间统一到冻结的 2015 eFUA。

boundary.note: Direct name and country match in GHS-FUA R2019A.
boundary.noteZh: 名称与国家均直接匹配 GHS-FUA R2019A。

rationale.en: Estimate 55 reflects the municipality's combined flood, heavy-rain, heat and drought concerns, with a larger water-exposure discount than the inland Swiss cases. Adaptation policy is not completed protection; -2/decade is an assumed rising physical burden, not a flood-probability estimate.
rationale.zh: 研究估计 55 反映市政府识别的洪水、暴雨、高温和干旱复合风险，水暴露折减大于瑞士内陆案例。适应政策不等于已完成保护；每十年 -2 是物理负担增加假设，不是洪灾概率估计。

rationale.en: Estimate 75 uses a comparatively stable European national baseline with nonzero geopolitical spillovers. The regional risk profile is preparedness context, not war-frequency evidence; -1/decade reflects global interstate deterioration without claiming a calibrated metropolitan probability.
rationale.zh: 研究估计 75 采用相对稳定的欧洲国家背景并保留地缘外溢。区域风险档案是备灾背景，不是战争频率证据；每十年 -1 反映全球国家间恶化，不声称校准的都市圈概率。

rationale.en: Estimate 75 balances institutional monitoring and public reporting against rising victimisation in the 2025 local survey. A district index cannot represent every resident, and cybercrime is counted here only; flat direction assumes adaptive capacity broadly offsets pressures.
rationale.zh: 研究估计 75 平衡制度监测与公开报告能力，以及 2025 本地调查受害率上升。区级指数不能代表所有居民，网络犯罪只在此考虑；方向 0 假设适应能力大体抵消压力。

rationale.en: Estimate 70 reflects an operating monitored water system but retains a material constraint for source-specific quality issues and incomplete energy/food redundancy evidence. The 2025 chlorate exceedances and 2026 standard change are not a simple trend; flat direction assumes ongoing control without guaranteed improvement.
rationale.zh: 研究估计 70 反映运行且受监测的供水系统，同时保留水源特定质量问题及能源粮食冗余证据不足的明显约束。2025 氯酸盐超标与 2026 标准变化不构成简单趋势；方向 0 假设持续控制而非保证改善。

rationale.en: Estimate 75 reflects organised public-health surveillance and a substantial clinical research/provider environment. Population health monitoring does not establish universal timely or affordable care; flat direction assumes system continuity and keeps eFUA access uncertainty explicit.
rationale.zh: 研究估计 75 反映有组织的公共卫生监测及较强临床研究/医疗环境。人群健康监测不证明人人及时、可负担就医；方向 0 假设系统延续，并明确 eFUA 准入不确定性。

rationale.en: Estimate 60 recognises the 31-person disease-specific senolytic Phase 2 trial but gives equal importance to resident accessibility. The fibrosis signal and higher adverse-event frequency do not establish general longevity benefit or routine affordable access. +1/decade assumes cautious translation and access development rather than extrapolation of trial efficacy.
rationale.zh: 研究估计 60 认可 31 人特定疾病衰老细胞清除二期试验，同时同等重视居民可及。纤维化信号和更高不良事件频率不证明普遍长寿获益或常规可负担准入。每十年 +1 假设谨慎转化与准入发展，不外推试验疗效。

rationale.en: Estimate 75 reflects a digitally engaged population and a dedicated municipal skills/barriers monitor, while representative productivity benefits remain unproven. +1/decade assumes gradual nonmedical adoption; digital exclusion constrains the baseline and cybercrime is not penalised twice.
rationale.zh: 研究估计 75 反映居民数字参与及市级技能/障碍监测，但代表性生产率收益未证明。每十年 +1 假设非医疗采用逐步增加；数字排斥约束基线，网络犯罪不重复扣分。

rationale.en: Estimate 85 reflects Schiphol's realised network of 300 destinations, including 124 intercontinental. Network reach is not residency or asset-transfer permission for each person; flat direction assumes continuity and retains nationality, cost and disruption limits.
rationale.zh: 研究估计 85 反映 Schiphol 已实现的 300 个目的地网络，其中洲际 124 个。网络可达不等于每个人的居留或资产转移许可；方向 0 假设延续并保留国籍、成本及中断限制。

summary.en: JMA Tokyo station 47662 reports 2025 mean temperature 17.3°C, maximum 38.5°C and precipitation 1,152.5 mm. These station observations do not measure FUA population exposure, wet-bulb heat or future hazard tails.
summary.zh: 气象厅东京 47662 站 2025 年均温 17.3°C、最高温 38.5°C、降水 1,152.5 毫米。站点观测不等于 FUA 人口暴露、湿球热风险或未来尾部风险。

summary.en: Tokyo amended its civil protection plan in 2025, including missile-attack response. A preparedness plan establishes responsibilities, not the probability of conflict or demonstrated shelter effectiveness.
summary.zh: 东京在 2025 年修订国民保护计划，包含导弹袭击应对。预案能证明职责安排，不能证明冲突概率或避难设施实际有效性。

summary.en: The July 2025 metropolitan opinion survey reports 53% saying their livelihood became harder, six percentage points higher. This measures perceived living conditions; the audited release alone does not establish institutional reliability or survey comparability.
summary.zh: 2025 年 7 月都民调查显示 53% 认为生活更困难，比此前高 6 个百分点。这是生活感受；已查阅的发布稿不足以证明制度可靠性或跨城调查可比性。

summary.en: Tokyo Waterworks reports FY2024 distribution of 1,528 million m³ and leakage of 53 million m³ (published rate 3.5%). Its 23-ward and 26 Tama municipality service area differs from the FUA; water leakage alone does not establish resource resilience.
summary.zh: 东京都水道局报告 2024 财年配水 15.28 亿立方米、漏水 0.53 亿立方米，公布漏水率 3.5%。服务区为 23 区及多摩 26 市町，与 FUA 不同；漏水率不能单独代表资源韧性。

summary.en: The 2024 Medical Facilities Survey/Hospital Report provides municipality bed tables, but its linked report returned HTTP 403 in this audit. No unverified bed count is admitted, and inventory would still require staffed capacity, outcomes and access denominators.
summary.zh: 已找到 2024 年医疗设施调查及医院报告的分市区町村床位表，但报告下载返回 HTTP 403。本次不采纳未经核实的床位数；设施存量仍需补充实际人员配置、结局和可及性分母。

summary.zh: jRCT 是相关日语注册源。检索到的东京相关外泌体试验详情无法访问（403），未核实阶段、结果、批准状态或居民可及性；注册记录不能证明长寿治疗可及。
