boundaryReview.en: Municipal, station, water-service, airport and Tokyo–Yokohama cluster observations are not spatially crosswalked to frozen eFUA 5129. Product-name matching does not validate these source areas.
boundaryReview.zh: 行政区、站点、水务服务区、机场和东京—横滨集群观测尚未与冻结 eFUA 5129 做空间适配；产品名称匹配不等于来源辖区适配。

boundary.note: Direct name and country match in GHS-FUA R2019A.
boundary.noteZh: 名称与国家均直接匹配 GHS-FUA R2019A。

rationale.en: Substantial seismic exposure in Tokyo’s disaster scenarios and observed summer heat place physical safety near the midpoint despite developed adaptation. The subjective -2/decade assumes warming gradually outweighs additional protection; it is not a hazard forecast. Station and administrative evidence do not resolve FUA exposure.
rationale.zh: 东京官方灾害情景揭示显著地震暴露，实测夏季高温叠加，使物理安全估在中位附近，适应能力只能部分抵消。主观每十年 -2 假设升温压力逐步超过新增防护，并非灾害预测；站点与行政证据仍不等于 FUA 暴露。

rationale.en: Civil-protection capacity supports a reasonably strong baseline, but regional nuclear/missile exposure prevents the 80-point redundancy anchor. The subjective -1/decade assumes persistent regional friction; neither preparedness plans nor Japanese national reporting quantify Tokyo attack probability.
rationale.zh: 民防组织能力支持较强基线，但区域核与导弹暴露使其达不到 80 分的强冗余锚点。主观每十年 -1 假设区域摩擦持续；预案及日本国家报告均不量化东京遭袭概率。

rationale.en: Established civil-protection coordination and detailed public-service reporting support the strong-capacity anchor. The livelihood survey signals pressure rather than institutional failure. A subjective flat trend assumes adaptive administration offsets social pressure; governance and cohesion are inferred across incomplete local evidence.
rationale.zh: 成熟民防协调及细致公共服务披露支持强能力锚点；生活困难调查体现压力而非制度失灵。主观持平假设行政适应抵消社会压力；治理与凝聚力判断综合了仍不完整的本地证据。

rationale.en: Low reported water leakage supports high operating capability, while earthquake disruption and unverified food/energy redundancy keep the estimate below 80. A subjective flat trend balances network renewal against ageing assets and external supply exposure; the water service area is not the FUA.
rationale.zh: 较低漏水率支持较高运营能力，但地震中断及尚未核实的粮能冗余使估计低于 80。主观持平假设管网更新抵消资产老化与外部供应暴露；水务服务区并非 FUA。

rationale.en: Japan’s broad core-service coverage and comparatively strong treatment outcomes provide a high national prior, alongside Tokyo’s documented facility system. The subjective -1/decade assumes care-demand pressure modestly exceeds capacity adaptation. This is not a measured Tokyo result, and the local bed table remained inaccessible.
rationale.zh: 日本广泛基础服务覆盖和较强治疗结局提供高国家先验，东京也有完整设施统计体系。主观每十年 -1 假设照护需求压力略超过扩容适应；并非东京实测结果，本地床位表仍未取得。

rationale.en: A mature medical system, innovation cluster and domestic trial registry imply moderate translation readiness, but verified longevity-specific maturity and resident access remain weakly evidenced. The subjective +2/decade assumes gradual translation and adoption, without counting unverified exosome results or claiming lifespan extension.
rationale.zh: 成熟医疗体系、创新集群与本国试验注册机制支持中等转化准备度，但长寿专项成熟度及居民准入证据薄弱。主观每十年 +2 假设渐进转化与采用，不计未经核实的外泌体结果，也不声称延寿效果。

rationale.en: The Tokyo–Yokohama patent cluster supports a high estimate of knowledge and industrial depth. Incomplete city diffusion evidence prevents a near-ideal score. Subjective +1/decade assumes incremental adoption in an already mature system; the wider cluster is an explicit geographic proxy.
rationale.zh: 东京—横滨专利集群支持知识与产业厚度的高估计，但城市技术扩散证据不全，不能接近理想上限。主观每十年 +1 假设成熟体系继续渐进采用；较大集群是明确的地理代理。

rationale.en: Large international-airport throughput supports substantial connectivity, but independent route continuity, legal residency and asset portability are not established for every resident. The subjective flat trend assumes connectivity persists without assuming broader migration rights. Airport-system evidence is a proxy, not a personal exit guarantee.
rationale.zh: 国际机场吞吐量支持较强连接能力，但独立通道连续性、合法居留及资产可携性并未对所有居民成立。主观持平假设连接持续，不假设迁移权自动扩大；机场系统证据只是代理，并非个人退出保证。

summary.en: MSS reports Changi mean temperature 28.1°C in 2025, 0.3°C above its long-term average. A single weather station does not provide population-weighted humid-heat exposure or future flood risk.
summary.zh: 气象署报告樟宜 2025 年均温 28.1°C，比长期均值高 0.3°C。单站不代表人口加权湿热暴露或未来洪水风险。

sources.title: Meteorological Service Singapore — The Year in Numbers 2025

summary.en: MHA’s 8 April 2026 parliamentary answer assesses increased spillover risk from the Middle East conflict. This is an authority threat assessment, not an independently estimated city attack probability or an incident count.
summary.zh: 内政部 2026 年 4 月 8 日国会答复评估中东冲突外溢风险上升。这是主管部门威胁判断，不是独立估计的城市袭击概率或事件次数。

sources.title: MHA — Threat risk level due to the conflict in the Middle East

summary.en: IPS’s 2024 race/religion survey reports 88% never or rarely being made fun of because of race/religion. This is self-reported social experience; subgroup coverage, nonresponse and question wording prevent treating it as a complete institutional score.
summary.zh: IPS 2024 年种族与宗教调查中，88% 表示从未或很少因种族或宗教被嘲弄。这是自述社会经验；群体覆盖、无回应和问题措辞限制其作为完整制度评分的用途。

sources.title: IPS Working Paper 64 — Prejudices, Attitudes and Critical Perspectives on Race in Singapore

summary.en: SFA reports that Singapore imported over 90% of food from more than 180 countries/regions in 2025. These are bounds, not exact percentages/counts; source diversity alone does not quantify concentration, stock cover or disruption resilience.
summary.zh: 食物局报告 2025 年逾 90% 食物依赖进口，来源超过 180 个国家或地区。这是范围值，不应改成精确数字；来源数不能证明集中度、库存天数或抗中断能力。

summary.en: MOH lists 12,767 acute hospital beds for 2025: 10,784 public, 334 not-for-profit and 1,649 private. Bed inventory does not establish staffing, clinical outcomes, affordability or equal resident access.
summary.zh: 卫生部列示 2025 年急性医院床位 12,767 张，其中公立 10,784、非营利 334、私立 1,649。床位存量不等于人员配置、临床结局、可负担性或居民平等可及。

sources.title: MOH — Beds in inpatient facilities and places in non-residential long-term care facilities

summary.en: HSA’s register covers ongoing trials in its applications database and relies on sponsor updates at least every six months. It does not establish a deduplicated longevity cohort, positive outcomes, approval or public access.
summary.zh: 卫生科学局注册表覆盖申请数据库中的在研试验，依赖申办方至少每六个月更新。它不能证明已去重的长寿试验队列、有效结果、批准或公众可及。

summary.en: The inspected 2025 IMDA report estimates the 2024 digital economy at S$128.1 billion (18.6% of GDP). The newer 2026 report was found but blocked by browser verification, so its values are excluded. National digital output does not measure resident technology access.
summary.zh: 已查阅的 IMDA 2025 报告估计 2024 年数字经济为 1,281 亿新元，占 GDP 18.6%。已找到 2026 年报告但访问受浏览器验证阻挡，未采纳其数值；数字产出不等于居民技术可及。

summary.en: ICA defines separate permanent-residence eligibility categories and assessment factors; permanent residents require a valid re-entry permit to return as residents. Eligibility is conditional and individual, not universal mobility or a city-level freedom-of-exit estimate.
summary.zh: 移民与关卡局规定不同永久居民申请类别和审核因素；永久居民以该身份再入境须持有效再入境许可。资格取决于个人条件，不能转成普遍迁移权或城市退出自由估计。

boundaryReview.en: City-state statistics are a plausible local source, but the national territory, Changi station and agency service universes have not been intersected with frozen eFUA 154. Equivalence remains unverified.
boundaryReview.zh: 城市国家统计具有较好的本地适配潜力，但国家疆域、樟宜站点和部门服务对象尚未与冻结 eFUA 154 相交核验，不能认定等价。

boundary.note: Bound to the Singapore-country eFUA record; the adjacent Malaysian record remains separate.
boundary.noteZh: 绑定新加坡国家范围内的 eFUA 记录；邻接的马来西亚记录保持独立。

rationale.en: Persistent tropical heat creates a material physical constraint despite strong urban operating capacity. The subjective -2/decade assumes increasing heat burden partly outpaces adaptation. Changi’s temperature is a local clue, not a population exposure model; unquantified flood and other hazards widen the interval.
rationale.zh: 持续热带高温构成重要物理约束，城市运营能力只能部分抵消。主观每十年 -2 假设热负担增长部分超过适应；樟宜温度是本地线索而非人口暴露模型，未量化洪水等风险扩大区间。

rationale.en: An established threat-assessment and response apparatus supports a strong security prior, while official spillover concerns justify remaining below the high-redundancy anchor. Subjective -1/decade assumes continuing external friction; it is not a conversion of the authority’s threat label into attack probability.
rationale.zh: 稳定威胁评估与应对体系支持较强安全先验，但官方外溢风险警示使其低于强冗余锚点。主观每十年 -1 假设外部摩擦延续；不是把官方威胁标签换算为袭击概率。

rationale.en: Resident social-experience evidence and institutional response capacity support a strong governance/cohesion estimate, while the survey cannot establish equal experience across groups. A subjective flat trend assumes continued administrative adaptation with persistent inclusion challenges; the score is an interpretation, not a survey percentage.
rationale.zh: 居民社会经验和机构应对能力支持较强治理与凝聚力估计，但调查不能证明各群体体验一致。主观持平假设行政适应持续而包容性挑战仍在；分数是解释性判断，不是调查比例。

rationale.en: Diverse food sourcing supports shock management, but very high import reliance prevents treating supplier count as physical self-sufficiency or spare capacity. Subjective +1/decade assumes diversification and management improve gradually while external dependence remains; energy and water redundancy are not fully audited.
rationale.zh: 多元食物来源支持冲击管理，但高度进口依赖意味着供应地数量不等于自给或备用能力。主观每十年 +1 假设多元化及管理渐进改善，同时外部依赖持续；能源和供水冗余尚未完整核验。

rationale.en: The observed public, nonprofit and private hospital capacity supports a strong system estimate. It does not prove equal affordability, outcomes or staffed surge capacity, so the ideal anchor is inappropriate. Subjective +1/decade assumes incremental expansion and coordination outweigh rising demand slightly.
rationale.zh: 公立、非营利与私立医院容量支持较强体系估计，但不证明支付公平、结局或实际应急人员配置，不能视为理想上限。主观每十年 +1 假设渐进扩容与协调略超过需求增长。

rationale.en: A functioning trial regulator, medical capacity and digital economy support relatively strong translation readiness, but sponsor-maintained trial registration is not evidence of longevity efficacy or routine access. Subjective +2/decade assumes gradual regulatory and delivery learning; no latest experimental-news bonus is included.
rationale.zh: 试验监管、医疗容量与数字经济支持相对较强转化准备度，但申办方维护的注册不证明长寿疗效或常规准入。主观每十年 +2 假设监管和交付能力渐进学习；未计最新实验新闻红利。

rationale.en: The scale of the documented digital economy supports a high capability estimate, while output share alone does not establish universal diffusion. Subjective +1/decade assumes continued adoption with diminishing gains in a mature system. The verified older observation is retained rather than substituting inaccessible 2026 figures.
rationale.zh: 已核实数字经济规模支持高能力估计，但产出占比不能证明普遍扩散。主观每十年 +1 假设成熟体系持续采用但边际收益递减；保留已核实旧观测，不替换成未读到的 2026 数字。

rationale.en: A developed administrative framework for residency and re-entry supports predictable options for eligible residents, but status-dependent rights prevent a universal high score. Subjective flat trend assumes current conditionality persists. Transport and asset portability remain broad contextual assumptions, not fully audited rights.
rationale.zh: 成熟居留与再入境制度为符合资格者提供可预期选项，但身份差异阻止普遍高分。主观持平假设现有条件性持续；交通和资产可携性仍属宽泛背景假设，并非已完整审定的权利。

summary.en: The municipal 2025 climate bulletin reports mean temperature 23.5°C and 60 hot days (炎热日). Its stated coverage includes Shenshan; the hot-day threshold was not verified, so it is not recoded as days above 35°C.
summary.zh: 深圳 2025 年气候公报报告年均温 23.5°C、炎热日 60 天，统计范围包含深汕。未核验炎热日阈值，不能改写为超过 35°C 的天数。

sources.title: 深圳市气象局 — 2025年深圳市气候公报

summary.en: The municipal emergency-shelter regulation and published shelter lists establish a preparedness framework. They do not measure conflict exposure, shelter occupancy/readiness or military attack risk; no city conflict probability is inferred.
summary.zh: 应急避难场所管理办法及公布的场所清单证明存在备灾制度，不证明冲突暴露、避难容量与就绪程度或军事袭击风险；不据此推断城市冲突概率。

sources.title: 深圳市应急避难场所管理办法政策解读
深圳市应急管理局 — 应急避难场所

summary.en: The 2025 municipal disclosure report records 13,569 information requests, 756 administrative reconsiderations and 295 lawsuits. These self-reported administrative volumes do not establish disclosure quality, fair outcomes or public trust.
summary.zh: 深圳 2025 年政府信息公开报告记载 13,569 件申请、756 件行政复议及 295 件行政诉讼。行政自报数量不能证明公开质量、公平结果或公众信任。

sources.title: 深圳市人民政府 — 政府信息公开年度报告

summary.en: The 2025 bulletin reports public water-supply capacity of 9.02 million m³/day and annual supply of 1.948 billion m³. Capacity and throughput do not establish outage frequency or drought reserves.
summary.zh: 2025 年公报报告公共供水能力每日 902 万立方米、全年供水 19.48 亿立方米。能力和供水量不等于停水频率或抗旱储备。

sources.title: 深圳市2025年国民经济和社会发展统计公报

summary.en: The 2025 bulletin lists 86,035 hospital beds, separately from 92,327 beds across health institutions. These preliminary inventories do not establish clinical quality or equitable access.
summary.zh: 2025 年公报列示医院床位 86,035 张，与全部卫生机构床位 92,327 张口径不同。初步存量不能证明临床质量或公平可及。

sources.title: 深圳市2025年国民经济和社会发展统计公报

summary.en: A November 2025 municipal scheme planned selection of two international clinical-trial demonstration institutions by year-end. This is a target, not two completed institutions, verified longevity trials, treatment efficacy or resident access.
summary.zh: 2025 年 11 月市级方案计划年底前遴选两家国际化临床试验示范机构。这是目标，不代表已建成两家，也不证明长寿试验、疗效或居民可及。

sources.title: 深圳市国际化临床试验示范机构建设方案

summary.en: The 2025 bulletin reports 19,660 PCT international patent applications. This administrative innovation input does not measure realized deployment, resident access or independent inventions after patent-family deduplication.
summary.zh: 2025 年公报报告 PCT 国际专利申请 19,660 件。这是创新行政投入记录，不能证明实际应用、居民可及或专利族去重后的独立发明数量。

sources.title: 深圳市2025年国民经济和社会发展统计公报

summary.en: The transport bureau reports 2025 airport passenger throughput of 66.4852 million. Throughput is not unique persons, visa eligibility, route redundancy or evacuation capacity.
summary.zh: 交通运输局报告 2025 年机场旅客吞吐量 6,648.52 万人次。吞吐量不是独立人数、签证资格、线路冗余或撤离能力。

sources.title: 深圳市交通运输局 — 2025年交通运输主要指标

boundaryReview.en: Local Shenzhen observations are not automatically observations of eFUA 9725, whose source name is Guangzhou and whose urban-centre list spans the Pearl River Delta. Shenzhen/Guangzhou alias and Shenshan coverage require a source-area-to-FUA crosswalk.
boundaryReview.zh: 深圳本地观测不能自动视为 eFUA 9725 的观测：该记录来源名称为 Guangzhou，城市中心跨珠三角。深圳／广州别名与深汕覆盖仍需来源辖区到 FUA 的空间适配。

boundary.note: The 2015 product merges the Pearl River Delta urban centre under Guangzhou and labels this eastern eFUA segment Guangzhou; the Shenzhen alias needs geospatial review.
boundary.noteZh: 2015 产品把珠三角城市中心合并并命名为 Guangzhou，此东部 eFUA 分段仍需完成深圳别名的空间审核。

rationale.en: A hot climate and a high reported hot-day count support a material physical constraint despite substantial urban capacity. Subjective -2/decade assumes heat pressure grows faster than part of the adaptation response; flood and severe-weather exposure are not quantified, and the bulletin includes Shenshan.
rationale.zh: 炎热气候和较多炎热日支持显著物理约束判断，城市能力只能部分抵消。主观每十年 -2 假设热压力超过部分适应增量；洪水及强天气暴露尚未量化，公报也包含深汕。

rationale.en: Emergency institutions support a capable response prior, but shelter records cannot establish conflict safety or strategic redundancy. The 60 estimate assumes a functioning city under material external strategic exposure, rather than treating missing events as safety. Subjective -1/decade represents a persistent-friction scenario, not a war forecast.
rationale.zh: 应急机构支持较强应对先验，但避难记录不能证明冲突安全或战略冗余。60 分假设城市正常运转同时有重要外部战略暴露，不把缺少事件当成安全；主观每十年 -1 表达摩擦持续情景而非战争预测。

rationale.en: The disclosure system and formal review channels support substantial administrative capacity, but request and appeal volumes do not establish fair outcomes, public trust or adaptation across all groups. Subjective +1/decade assumes process and service improvements; the uncertainty includes reporting incentives and limited independent outcomes.
rationale.zh: 信息公开体系及正式复议渠道支持较强行政能力，但申请和申诉数量不能证明公平结果、信任或各群体适应。主观每十年 +1 假设流程与服务改善；区间包含自报激励及独立结果不足。

rationale.en: Large observed public-water capacity supports substantial service delivery, but capacity is not continuity and food/energy reserves remain incompletely known. Subjective +1/decade assumes infrastructure improvement partly offsets demand growth. Administrative Shenzhen is a proxy for a much wider functional-area record.
rationale.zh: 较大公共供水能力支持较强服务交付，但容量不等于连续性，粮能储备仍不完整。主观每十年 +1 假设基础设施改善部分抵消需求增长；深圳行政区是更大功能区记录的代理。

rationale.en: The observed hospital-bed base supports capacity above the 60 anchor, but inventory alone cannot justify the 80 quality/access anchor. Subjective +2/decade assumes expanding specialist and delivery capabilities, with equitable access and staffed continuity still uncertain; this is not an extrapolated bed-growth forecast.
rationale.zh: 医院床位基础支持高于 60 的容量判断，但存量不足以支撑 80 的质量与可及性锚点。主观每十年 +2 假设专科和交付能力扩展，公平可及与实际人员连续性仍不确定；并非床位增速预测。

rationale.en: Medical capacity and a formal trial-development programme suggest intermediate translation readiness, but programme targets do not prove completed trial infrastructure or longevity access. Subjective +2/decade assumes partial execution and learning. No efficacy, completed demonstration-centre count or routine treatment availability is inferred.
rationale.zh: 医疗容量与正式临床试验建设计划提示中等转化准备度，但计划目标不证明试验基础设施已完成或长寿可及。主观每十年 +2 假设部分落地及学习，不推断疗效、已建成示范机构数或常规治疗可得。

rationale.en: The large PCT application base supports substantial invention and industry depth; patents are not equivalent to independent inventions or universal diffusion. Subjective +2/decade assumes continuing commercialization and adoption. The administrative-to-FUA mismatch widens uncertainty rather than generating an invented spatial adjustment.
rationale.zh: 较大 PCT 申请基础支持发明和产业厚度，但专利不等于独立发明或普遍扩散。主观每十年 +2 假设商业化与采用持续；行政区到 FUA 不匹配扩大不确定性，不虚构空间修正。

rationale.en: Large airport throughput supports useful connections, while legally usable residency, asset portability and genuinely independent routes remain person- and jurisdiction-dependent. Subjective +1/decade assumes transport and digital continuity improve, not automatic liberalization of legal rights. The score is a broad capability prior.
rationale.zh: 较大机场吞吐支持实用连接，但可执行居留、资产可携性和真正独立通道取决于个人身份及司法辖区。主观每十年 +1 假设交通和数字连续性改善，不假设法律权利自动放宽；分数属于宽泛能力先验。

summary.en: Seoul’s official indicator portal displays a 2025 annual mean temperature of 14.1°C. The overview does not identify a population-weighted station network or humid-heat distribution, limiting its use to a reported local observation.
summary.zh: 首尔官方统计门户显示 2025 年均温 14.1°C。概览未提供人口加权站网或湿热分布，故仅作为本地原始观测。

summary.en: The city safety map exposes civil-defence shelter and emergency-water layers. Availability of a map is not verified shelter capacity, operational readiness or probability of conflict.
summary.zh: 市安全地图提供民防避难所与应急供水图层。地图存在不能证明实际避难容量、运转就绪或冲突概率。

sources.title: 서울안전누리 — 재난안전시설 지도
sources.period: Map inspected 2026-10-09; facility observation dates not established

summary.en: The 2025 Seoul Survey fieldwork covered 20,000 households, a 5,000-person citizen sample and 2,500 registered foreigners. The result archive is available, but weighted institutional outcomes were not extracted; a sampling plan cannot substitute for responses.
summary.zh: 2025 年首尔调查包括 20,000 户家庭、5,000 名市民样本和 2,500 名登记外国人。结果归档已发布，但本次未提取加权制度评价；抽样安排不能替代调查结果。

summary.en: Arisu’s 2025 tap-water report describes compliant samples at libraries in all 25 districts. This selected-site quality result does not establish household-wide coverage or continuity. Conflicting parameter totals on the page are excluded.
summary.zh: Arisu 2025 年自来水报告描述在全部 25 个区的图书馆采样合格。这是选定点位水质结果，不等于全体家庭覆盖或供水连续性；页面存在不一致的检测项目总数，本次不采纳该数。

summary.en: The official city overview lists 19,567 medical institutions for 2025. This heterogeneous facility count does not identify staffed acute beds, specialties, outcomes or resident access.
summary.zh: 官方城市概览列示 2025 年医疗机构 19,567 家。异质机构总数不能证明实际急性床位、专科能力、结局或居民可及。

summary.en: KDCA’s CRIS provides Korean-language clinical-study registration and search. Its national all-disease totals cannot be treated as Seoul longevity trials; no deduplicated city cohort, positive outcomes or treatment access is established by the inspected portal.
summary.zh: 疾控厅 CRIS 提供韩语临床研究注册和检索。全国全病种总量不能当作首尔长寿试验；已查门户不证明城市去重队列、有效结果或治疗可及。

summary.en: The city reports 35,318 operating public Wi-Fi units on 9 April 2026 and 40,479 TB of traffic in 2025. These infrastructure/traffic measures do not prove universal coverage or uptime; its 2,020-unit replacement programme is a plan.
summary.zh: 市政府 2026 年 4 月 9 日报告运行中公共 Wi-Fi 35,318 台，2025 年流量 40,479 TB。设备与流量不证明普遍覆盖或在线率；更换 2,020 台的项目属于计划。

summary.en: The city portal reports 2,744,128 thousand subway passenger movements in 2025. Trips are not unique people or independent exit routes; local transit volume does not establish legal portability or international mobility.
summary.zh: 市统计门户报告 2025 年地铁客运 2,744,128 千人次。乘次不是独立人数或独立退出通道，本地客运量不能证明法律可携性或国际迁移能力。

boundaryReview.en: Seoul municipal statistics and Arisu service evidence have not been crosswalked to eFUA 94, which includes five urban-centre IDs. A Seoul name match does not show that city-only numerators cover the complete functional area.
boundaryReview.zh: 首尔行政统计和 Arisu 服务证据尚未与包含五个城市中心 ID 的 eFUA 94 适配；名称一致不能证明市域分子覆盖完整功能区。

boundary.note: Direct name and country match in GHS-FUA R2019A.
boundary.noteZh: 名称与国家均直接匹配 GHS-FUA R2019A。

rationale.en: Local climate observations and a developed emergency-facility system support capable adaptation with remaining heat and multi-hazard constraints. Subjective -2/decade assumes warming gradually erodes that margin. The mean temperature is not a hazard distribution, so this is a comparative structural judgment with a wide interval.
rationale.zh: 本地气候观测与成熟应急设施体系支持较强适应，但仍受高温及多灾种约束。主观每十年 -2 假设升温渐进侵蚀余量；均温不等于风险分布，因此这是带宽区间的结构性比较判断。

rationale.en: Civil-defence infrastructure moderates risk, but proximity to the Korean peninsula’s nuclear/missile confrontation creates a stronger structural exposure than the other four cities. Subjective -1/decade assumes persistent confrontation, not certain conflict. National diplomatic reporting provides context rather than a Seoul attack probability.
rationale.zh: 民防设施有缓释作用，但朝鲜半岛核与导弹对峙的地理邻近性使首尔结构暴露高于其余四城。主观每十年 -1 假设对峙持续，并非必然冲突；国家外交资料仅为背景，不是首尔遭袭概率。

rationale.en: Broad resident/foreigner survey infrastructure and operational service reporting support strong feedback and delivery capacity, without proving survey satisfaction or equal treatment. Subjective flat trend assumes adaptive institutions balance social pressures. This judgment uses institutional mechanisms, not fabricated unextracted survey outcomes.
rationale.zh: 覆盖居民与外国人的调查基础设施及运营服务披露支持较强反馈与交付能力，但不证明满意度或平等待遇。主观持平假设制度适应抵消社会压力；依据的是制度机制，并未编造未提取的调查结果。

rationale.en: Reported local water-quality compliance supports a strong public-service prior, while selected-site sampling cannot establish universal continuity or food/energy redundancy. Subjective flat trend balances maintenance and adaptation against demand and external supply exposure; the service geography remains a proxy.
rationale.zh: 本地水质合格记录支持较强公共服务先验，但选点采样不能证明普遍连续性或粮能冗余。主观持平平衡维护适应、需求及外部供应暴露；服务地理仍是代理。

rationale.en: National core-service coverage and a large local facility base support a strong capacity estimate; Korea’s comparatively limited financial coverage constrains the access interpretation. Subjective flat trend assumes medical advances offset demand and affordability pressures. Country-level outcomes are priors, not Seoul observations.
rationale.zh: 国家基础服务覆盖及较大本地机构基础支持较强容量；韩国相对有限的费用覆盖限制可及性判断。主观持平假设医疗进步抵消需求与负担压力；国家结局只是先验，并非首尔观测。

rationale.en: The medical base and Korean-language trial infrastructure support moderate translation readiness, but no deduplicated local longevity cohort or routine access was verified. Subjective +2/decade assumes gradual research-to-care development, not demonstrated lifespan extension or an automatic benefit from registry size.
rationale.zh: 医疗基础和韩语试验基础设施支持中等转化准备度，但未核实本地去重长寿队列或常规准入。主观每十年 +2 假设研究到临床渐进发展，不代表已证明延寿，也不按注册数量自动加分。

rationale.en: Extensive operating public Wi-Fi and substantial traffic support a high diffusion/infrastructure prior, with knowledge and industry depth less directly audited. Subjective +1/decade assumes incremental quality gains in a mature network. Planned equipment replacements are not counted as completed output.
rationale.zh: 广泛运行的公共 Wi-Fi 与较大流量支持高扩散及基础设施先验，但知识与产业厚度直接审计较少。主观每十年 +1 假设成熟网络质量渐进改善；计划更换设备未按完成产出计入。

rationale.en: Heavy subway use and digital infrastructure support strong local network continuity, but do not by themselves prove independent international exits, legal mobility or asset portability. Subjective flat trend assumes a capable network with persistent geographic and status constraints; personal exit rights remain heterogeneous.
rationale.zh: 较大地铁运量及数字设施支持较强本地网络连续性，但不能单独证明独立国际退出、法律迁移或资产可携。主观持平假设网络能力持续而地理及身份约束仍在；个人退出权仍有差异。

summary.en: The municipality distinguishes coastal, rainfall and river flooding and publishes local flood guides. These planning materials identify mechanisms but do not provide a comparable greater-Melbourne population exposure or geophysical tail test.
summary.zh: 市府区分海岸、降雨与河流洪水并提供当地防洪指南；规划材料识别风险机制，但未提供可比的大墨尔本人口暴露或地质尾部风险测试。

summary.en: Victoria’s official catalog exposes recorded-offence tables. Police administrative offences require council-to-eFUA mapping, denominator checks and underreporting review; no metro organized-violence or strategic-exposure score was extracted.
summary.zh: 维州官方目录提供报案犯罪统计表。警方行政记录需核对地方政府辖区到 eFUA 的映射、分母及漏报；未提取都市圈有组织暴力或战略暴露评分。

sources.title: Crime Statistics Agency Data tables - Recorded offences

summary.en: Prepare Melbourne documents community engagement and preparedness for heat, utility loss and other emergencies. Participation and plans are context, not independently measured metropolitan recovery or governance outcomes.
summary.zh: Prepare Melbourne 记录社区参与及高温、公用设施中断等应急准备。参与与计划仅作背景，不等于独立测量的都市圈恢复能力或治理结果。

sources.title: Community Resilience Assessment
sources.period: Prepare Melbourne four-year project; period not explicit on page

summary.en: Storage fell from 86.5% at the start of 2024/25 to 71.5% on 30 June 2025; catchment rainfall was 839 mm, 19.9% below the 30-year average. Utility observations are not household reliability or a food/energy assessment; no normalized score is assigned.
summary.zh: 2024/25 年度库容从年初 86.5% 降至 2025 年 6 月 30 日的 71.5%；集水区降雨 839 毫米，较 30 年均值低 19.9%。公用事业观测不等于家庭供水可靠性或食品、能源评估；未分配归一化分数。

summary.en: The hospital publishes statutory operational, care-volume and financial reports. One tertiary hospital cannot represent access or routine care across the metropolis; no population denominator or systemwide continuity estimate was extracted.
summary.zh: 医院公开法定运营、服务量及财务报告。单一三级医院不能代表全都市圈就医与常规医疗；未提取人口分母或全系统连续性估计。

summary.en: Monash’s research repository lists extended ASPREE follow-up on cardiovascular events and bleeding in older adults. Research output is not evidence of a generally approved longevity therapy or equitable resident access; registry reconciliation is incomplete.
summary.zh: 莫纳什科研库列出 ASPREE 关于老年人心血管事件与出血的延长随访成果。科研产出不能证明普遍获批的延寿疗法或公平居民可及性；试验注册记录尚未对齐。

summary.en: The city describes a knowledge economy and proposed economic actions. A draft strategy is not a current observation of knowledge output, innovation diffusion or metro industry density; no promotional claim becomes a score.
summary.zh: 市府描述知识经济和拟议经济行动。策略草案不是当前科研产出、创新普及或都市圈产业密度观测；不把宣传性主张转换成评分。

summary.en: Official table reports metropolitan train punctuality of 94.5% and reliability of 99.1% for June 2025. Definitions are contractual and mode-specific; this old month is not 2026 performance or full transport redundancy, and legal/asset mobility remain unmeasured.
summary.zh: 官方表列示 2025 年 6 月都市火车准点率 94.5%、可靠性 99.1%。定义依合同和交通方式而异；旧月份不代表 2026 年绩效或完整交通冗余，法律与资产迁移能力仍未测量。

boundaryReview.en: The existing candidate records a direct name/country match. This review did not spatially reconcile municipal, operator or provincial observations with the 2015 GHS-FUA polygon; local observations are not yet qualified as eFUA scoring inputs.
boundaryReview.zh: 既有候选数据记录名称与国家直接匹配。本次未将市界、运营商或省级观测与 2015 年 GHS-FUA 多边形进行空间对齐；当地观测尚未具备作为 eFUA 评分输入的资格。

boundary.note: Direct name and country match in GHS-FUA R2019A.
boundary.noteZh: 名称与国家均直接匹配 GHS-FUA R2019A。

rationale.en: Research estimate 60/100 (judgment half-width ±15); subjective long-run direction -2/decade. Heat, coastal and river flooding create meaningful exposure despite active planning; the negative direction assumes climate intensification partly exceeds adaptation.
rationale.zh: 研究估计 60/100（判断半宽 ±15）；主观长期方向每十年 -2 分。高温、海岸及河流洪水构成明显暴露，主动规划只能部分抵消；负向假设气候增强部分超过适应进展。

rationale.en: Research estimate 80/100 (judgment half-width ±18); subjective long-run direction +0/decade. Official offence reporting and Australian national background support relatively strong security; council-level data cannot settle strategic exposure, so a stable direction retains a wide judgment range.
rationale.zh: 研究估计 80/100（判断半宽 ±18）；主观长期方向每十年 +0 分。官方犯罪报告及澳大利亚国家背景支持相对较强安全；地方政府数据不能解决战略暴露，因此采用稳定方向与较宽判断区间。

rationale.en: Research estimate 80/100 (judgment half-width ±15); subjective long-run direction +1/decade. Community preparedness and established municipal programmes support strong adaptive institutions; slight improvement assumes plans become practical recovery capacity.
rationale.zh: 研究估计 80/100（判断半宽 ±15）；主观长期方向每十年 +1 分。社区应急准备及既有市政项目支持较强适应制度；小幅改善假设计划转化为实际恢复能力。

rationale.en: Research estimate 65/100 (judgment half-width ±15); subjective long-run direction -2/decade. Large storage and managed water systems provide capacity, but the observed storage decline and rainfall deficit reveal constraints; adverse direction assumes persistent climate-demand pressure.
rationale.zh: 研究估计 65/100（判断半宽 ±15）；主观长期方向每十年 -2 分。大型水库和管理体系提供能力，但观测到的库容下降与降雨不足显示约束；负向假设气候和需求压力持续。

rationale.en: Research estimate 80/100 (judgment half-width ±15); subjective long-run direction +1/decade. Statutory hospital reporting and major clinical institutions support strong care capacity; single-provider evidence leaves metropolitan access uncertain, with gradual improvement assumed.
rationale.zh: 研究估计 80/100（判断半宽 ±15）；主观长期方向每十年 +1 分。法定医院报告及重要临床机构支持较强医疗能力；单一机构证据使都市圈可及性不确定，假设缓慢改善。

rationale.en: Research estimate 60/100 (judgment half-width ±18); subjective long-run direction +2/decade. Monash and ASPREE support ageing-research and clinical-trial readiness, but research strength is not proof of broadly accessible validated regenerative or longevity interventions. The constrained level reflects the translation-access gap; growth assumes evidence-based delivery improves.
rationale.zh: 研究估计 60/100（判断半宽 ±18）；主观长期方向每十年 +2 分。莫纳什及 ASPREE 支持老龄科研和临床试验准备度，但科研优势不能证明居民广泛可及经验证的再生或长寿干预。受限水平体现转化与可及性缺口；增长假设循证交付改善。

rationale.en: Research estimate 80/100 (judgment half-width ±18); subjective long-run direction +1/decade. The municipal knowledge-economy strategy and research base support a strong capability estimate; strategy is not measured diffusion, so growth stays modest and uncertainty broad.
rationale.zh: 研究估计 80/100（判断半宽 ±18）；主观长期方向每十年 +1 分。市级知识经济策略及科研基础支持较强能力估计；策略不是已测量普及，因此增长保持温和且不确定性较宽。

rationale.en: Research estimate 70/100 (judgment half-width ±15); subjective long-run direction +1/decade. Observed train punctuality and reliability support workable transport options, with incomplete all-mode redundancy; positive direction assumes operational gains, not increased migration rights.
rationale.zh: 研究估计 70/100（判断半宽 ±15）；主观长期方向每十年 +1 分。火车准点率及可靠性观测支持有效出行选择，但多方式冗余不完整；正向假设运营改善，不代表迁移权利增加。

summary.en: Dubai Municipality announced four drainage projects costing AED 1.439 billion, expected by 2027. Planned capacity is not delivered protection; population-weighted heat/humidity and flood exposure were not extracted. Arabic source was machine-assisted read, not independently translated.
summary.zh: 迪拜市政宣布四项排水项目，总值 14.39 亿迪拉姆，预计 2027 年完成。规划容量不等于已实现防护；未提取按人口加权的高温湿度与洪水暴露。阿拉伯语内容经机器辅助阅读，未独立翻译复核。

summary.en: English official-domain crime searches and direct access did not yield inspectable current table data; the police endpoint timed out. No numerical crime claim, zero-conflict assumption or geopolitical tail verdict is made.
summary.zh: 以英语检索警方官方域名并直接访问，未取得可检查的当前统计表，警方端点访问超时。不作犯罪数值断言、零冲突假设或地缘政治尾部风险判断。

summary.en: Dubai Statistics Center publishes a statistical quality charter. A formal data-governance commitment is not verification of reporting independence, social cohesion or emergency recovery outcomes; independent comparable outcome evidence was not established.
summary.zh: 迪拜统计中心公开统计质量章程。正式数据治理承诺不能验证报送独立性、社会凝聚力或应急恢复结果；尚未取得独立可比的结果证据。

sources.title: Charter of Quality of Statistical Data

summary.en: DEWA reports 62.21 TWh power generation and desalinated-water demand of 161.505 billion imperial gallons in 2025. These show system scale and desalination dependence, not resilience during fuel, power or shipping disruption; operator incentives and service boundaries matter.
summary.zh: DEWA 报告 2025 年发电 62.21 TWh、海水淡化水需求 161.505 十亿英制加仑。这体现系统规模及海淡依赖，不能证明燃料、电力或航运中断时的韧性；需保留运营商激励和服务边界限制。

summary.en: DHA lists a household health survey and public/private clinical-capacity studies. Listing availability is not a completed sample and access audit; migrant eligibility, financial access and FUA population alignment were not resolved.
summary.zh: DHA 列出家庭健康调查及公私部门临床容量研究。发现资料不等于完成样本与可及性审核；移民资格、经济可及性和 FUA 人口对应仍未解决。

summary.en: Dubai Law 17/2026, issued 6 June 2026, establishes a Longevity Authority with trial and treatment oversight, alongside the DHA clinical-trials framework. Legal institutions do not prove therapeutic efficacy, mature trial outcomes or affordable resident access; no city trial count is certified.
summary.zh: 迪拜于 2026 年 6 月 6 日颁布第 17 号法律，设立负责试验与治疗监督的长寿管理局，与 DHA 临床试验框架并行。法律机构不证明疗效、成熟试验结局或居民可负担性；未认证城市试验数量。

sources.title: Law No. (17) of 2026 Establishing the Dubai Longevity Authority
sources.period: Issued 2026-06-06; commencement tied to Gazette publication

summary.en: Digital Dubai describes government AI use cases and its ecosystem. Selected cases and strategic ambition are producer self-report, not independent household diffusion or knowledge-output measures; no AI reputation bonus is assigned.
summary.zh: Digital Dubai 介绍政府 AI 案例与生态。精选案例及战略目标属于生产方自报，不是独立家庭普及或科研产出测量；不增加 AI 声誉分。

summary.en: RTA publishes a 2025 annual report and transport data access. No comparable all-mode disruption redundancy measure was extracted, and local ridership cannot establish immigration rights or asset portability.
summary.zh: RTA 公开 2025 年年报及交通数据入口。未提取可比的多方式中断冗余指标，本地乘客量也不能证明移民权利或资产可携性。

boundaryReview.en: The existing candidate records a direct name/country match. This review did not spatially reconcile municipal, operator or provincial observations with the 2015 GHS-FUA polygon; local observations are not yet qualified as eFUA scoring inputs.
boundaryReview.zh: 既有候选数据记录名称与国家直接匹配。本次未将市界、运营商或省级观测与 2015 年 GHS-FUA 多边形进行空间对齐；当地观测尚未具备作为 eFUA 评分输入的资格。

boundary.note: Direct name and country match in GHS-FUA R2019A.
boundary.noteZh: 名称与国家均直接匹配 GHS-FUA R2019A。

rationale.en: Research estimate 35/100 (judgment half-width ±18); subjective long-run direction -3/decade. Heat-humidity exposure and major planned drainage works indicate substantial physical constraints; stronger negative direction assumes worsening climate, while announced protection is not counted as delivered.
rationale.zh: 研究估计 35/100（判断半宽 ±18）；主观长期方向每十年 -3 分。高温湿度暴露及大规模拟建排水工程表明明显物理约束；较强负向假设气候恶化，不将宣布的防护视为已交付。

rationale.en: Research estimate 45/100 (judgment half-width ±20); subjective long-run direction -1/decade. Gulf strategic exposure is treated as a material regional-background constraint; the inaccessible police table means no crime rate is inferred. Slight deterioration is an uncertainty-aware assumption, not an event forecast. The cited event dataset is a research reference; no local event extraction supports this number.
rationale.zh: 研究估计 45/100（判断半宽 ±20）；主观长期方向每十年 -1 分。将海湾战略暴露作为重要地区背景约束；警方统计表无法访问，不推导犯罪率。小幅恶化是考虑不确定性的假设，非事件预测。 所引事件数据集仅为研究参考，没有当地事件提取直接支持此数值。

rationale.en: Research estimate 65/100 (judgment half-width ±18); subjective long-run direction +1/decade. Statistical standards and coordinated infrastructure programmes support meaningful administrative capacity; independent outcomes and inclusion remain weakly evidenced, so improvement is modest.
rationale.zh: 研究估计 65/100（判断半宽 ±18）；主观长期方向每十年 +1 分。统计标准及协调基础设施项目支持较强行政能力；独立结果和包容性证据较弱，因此仅假设小幅改善。

rationale.en: Research estimate 45/100 (judgment half-width ±18); subjective long-run direction -1/decade. DEWA demonstrates large operational capacity, but desalinated-water dependence links water to energy continuity; slight decline assumes demand and compound disruption risks offset investment.
rationale.zh: 研究估计 45/100（判断半宽 ±18）；主观长期方向每十年 -1 分。DEWA 展示大型运营能力，但海淡依赖将用水与能源连续性相连；小幅下降假设需求和复合中断风险抵消部分投资。

rationale.en: Research estimate 70/100 (judgment half-width ±18); subjective long-run direction +2/decade. Household surveys and public/private capacity planning support substantial clinical provision; migrant and financial access gaps limit confidence, while investment is assumed to improve delivery.
rationale.zh: 研究估计 70/100（判断半宽 ±18）；主观长期方向每十年 +2 分。家庭调查及公私医疗容量规划支持较强医疗供给；移民和经济可及性缺口限制信心，假设投资提升服务交付。

rationale.en: Research estimate 45/100 (judgment half-width ±20); subjective long-run direction +3/decade. The new Longevity Authority and trial framework provide regulatory preparation, not mature clinical translation or broad affordable access to validated regenerative or longevity interventions. Faster assumed growth starts from this constrained base and depends on implementation and evidence.
rationale.zh: 研究估计 45/100（判断半宽 ±20）；主观长期方向每十年 +3 分。新长寿管理局及试验框架提供监管准备，并非成熟临床转化或居民广泛可负担的经验证再生、长寿干预。较快增长假设从这一受限基础起步，依赖实际落实和证据积累。

rationale.en: Research estimate 75/100 (judgment half-width ±18); subjective long-run direction +2/decade. Documented government AI use cases support substantial deployment capacity; selected self-reported cases are not independent economy-wide diffusion, so high ambition receives only a qualified positive direction.
rationale.zh: 研究估计 75/100（判断半宽 ±18）；主观长期方向每十年 +2 分。已记录政府 AI 案例支持较强部署能力；精选自报案例不是独立全经济普及测量，因此对较高投入仅给予有限正向假设。

rationale.en: Research estimate 60/100 (judgment half-width ±20); subjective long-run direction +0/decade. Organized transport services support practical options, but residency, asset portability and regional disruption are not verified; the mid-range estimate and flat direction explicitly reflect those constraints.
rationale.zh: 研究估计 60/100（判断半宽 ±20）；主观长期方向每十年 +0 分。有组织交通服务支持实际选择，但居留、资产可携性及区域中断尚未核实；中等估计与持平方向明确考虑这些约束。

summary.en: BNPB reports 50 neighbourhood units inundated in South/East Jakarta on 6 July 2025, with water depths of 40–270 cm. This event snapshot is not an annual probability or a complete FUA loss estimate; BNPB relays local BPBD reporting.

summary.en: MRT Jakarta reports 4,173,621 passenger trips in November 2025 (139,121 daily average). These operating-system trips do not establish unique users, wider metropolitan coverage, network independence or legal exit options.

Original 1 km geometry checks established that the five Jakarta-named records are non-overlapping segments. The release explicitly keeps only 4897 (5,292 km²); this does not validate local-data geography.

boundary.note: Explicitly limited to eFUA 4897 (5,292 km²). The five Jakarta-named records have zero overlapping 1 km cells; they are distinct segments, not duplicated geometries. The other four segments and the administrative province are not silently merged.
boundary.noteZh: 范围明确限于 eFUA 4897（5,292 km²）。五条 Jakarta 同名记录的 1 km 单元互不重叠，属于不同分段而非重复几何；不静默合并其他四段，也不等同于行政省。

rationale.en: Observed deep neighbourhood flooding indicates substantial physical vulnerability, placing the structural estimate below the 40 constraint anchor. Subjective -2/decade assumes climate and urban exposure pressures partly outpace adaptation. A single event does not estimate annual probability, and wider FUA conditions remain uncertain.
rationale.zh: 邻里深水受淹记录显示明显物理脆弱性，结构估计低于 40 的约束锚点。主观每十年 -2 假设气候与城市暴露压力部分超过适应；单次事件不估计年概率，更大 FUA 状况仍不确定。

rationale.en: An operating national counterterrorism apparatus supports a capable baseline, while the acknowledged continuing threat rules out an exceptionally safe assumption. Subjective flat trend assumes containment without elimination. This uses national security context; no local incident count or attack probability was established.
rationale.zh: 运行中的国家反恐体系支持较强基线，但已确认的持续威胁排除极高安全假设。主观持平假设威胁受控而非消除；依据国家安全背景，并未建立本地事件数或袭击概率。

rationale.en: The published provincial institutional assessment and functioning public-service channels support an intermediate capability judgment, while the composite index is not directly reused as the score. Subjective +1/decade assumes gradual administrative learning; city/FUA mismatch, outcome gaps and uneven implementation keep uncertainty high.
rationale.zh: 省级制度评估和运行中的公共服务渠道支持中等能力判断，但未直接照搬综合指数作为分数。主观每十年 +1 假设行政渐进学习；市域与 FUA 不匹配、结果缺口及执行不均使不确定性较高。

rationale.en: The dated water-service coverage below universal provision indicates meaningful basic-service constraints despite an expanding system. Subjective +2/decade assumes gradual connection and operating improvements, not automatic completion of coverage targets. Safe continuous supply, energy and food redundancy remain less established.
rationale.zh: 有日期且未达普及的供水覆盖说明基础服务仍受明显约束，同时系统在扩展。主观每十年 +2 假设连接与运营渐进改善，不把覆盖目标视为必然实现；安全连续供水及粮能冗余仍较不明确。

rationale.en: WHO’s national evidence indicates improving service coverage but important financial and noncommunicable-disease gaps; local health-service infrastructure supports an intermediate city prior. Subjective +2/decade assumes gradual access and workforce improvement. National conditions are not a measured Jakarta result, and local capacity data remain incomplete.
rationale.zh: WHO 国家证据显示服务覆盖改善，但支付及慢病服务仍有重要缺口；本地卫生服务基础设施支持中等城市先验。主观每十年 +2 假设可及性与人员逐步改善；国家状况不是雅加达实测，本地容量数据仍不全。

rationale.en: A national clinical-research centre in Jakarta and a registry provide a starting platform, while specialist longevity translation and equitable routine access remain unverified. Subjective +2/decade assumes institutional learning from this early base; the score does not penalize an absence of proven lifespan extension unique to Jakarta.
rationale.zh: 雅加达国家临床研究中心及注册表提供起步平台，但长寿专项转化与公平常规准入未核实。主观每十年 +2 假设从较早期基础积累制度能力；不是因为雅加达缺少已证实延寿疗法而单独扣分。

rationale.en: Operating transport and public-service systems suggest meaningful deployment capacity, but current technology-access figures were not verified. The 60 baseline is a broad urban-capability prior rather than a fabricated survey estimate. Subjective +2/decade assumes catch-up diffusion with substantial implementation uncertainty.
rationale.zh: 运行中的交通及公共服务系统提示实质应用能力，但当前技术可及数值未核实。60 分是宽泛城市能力先验，不是编造的调查估计；主观每十年 +2 假设追赶式扩散，同时保留较大执行不确定性。

rationale.en: Observed MRT use supports functioning local transport options, while metropolitan reach, independent exit routes and resident-specific legal/asset portability remain unevenly evidenced. Subjective +2/decade assumes gradual network development, without treating passenger growth as a guarantee of migration rights or crisis evacuation.
rationale.zh: MRT 使用记录支持可运行的本地交通选项，但都会区覆盖、独立退出路线及个人法律与资产可携证据不均。主观每十年 +2 假设网络渐进发展，不把客运增长当作迁移权或危机撤离保证。

summary.en: The municipal portal provides climate plans and monitoring reports. Plan existence does not establish completed flood/heat adaptation or population-weighted eFUA risk; no scenario score was inferred from political targets.
summary.zh: 市府门户提供气候计划及监测报告。计划存在不证明已完成防洪降温适应，也不代表按人口加权的 eFUA 风险；未从政策目标推导情景分数。

summary.zh: FAPESP 说明采用公共行政、微观数据及商业论文数据库。指标主要涉及圣保罗州或巴西，非市界或 eFUA；上游重叠与论文语言覆盖限制使其不能简单叠加为多个独立指标。

summary.en: Metrô explicitly excludes private-concession metro lines and supplier/third-party operations from reporting. Operator results therefore cannot represent the whole metropolitan transport network or redundancy; legal and asset mobility remain unmeasured.
summary.zh: Metrô 明确排除私营特许地铁线及供应商、第三方运营资料。因此运营商结果不能代表全都市圈交通网络或冗余；法律与资产迁移能力仍未测量。

rationale.en: Research estimate 45/100 (judgment half-width ±18); subjective long-run direction -2/decade. Municipal climate planning acknowledges significant heat and flood constraints; negative direction assumes exposure grows faster than uneven implementation.
rationale.zh: 研究估计 45/100（判断半宽 ±18）；主观长期方向每十年 -2 分。市级气候规划承认明显高温与洪水约束；负向假设暴露增长快于不均衡实施。

rationale.en: Research estimate 45/100 (judgment half-width ±20); subjective long-run direction +0/decade. rationale.en: Research estimate 55/100 (judgment half-width ±18); subjective long-run direction +1/decade. rationale.zh: 研究估计 55/100（判断半宽 ±18）；主观长期方向每十年 +1 分。市级廉政报告及气候项目说明制度正常运转，但实施与区域协调限制能力；逐步改善属于假设而非观测。

rationale.en: Research estimate 50/100 (judgment half-width ±18); subjective long-run direction -1/decade. Systematic utility sampling supports basic capacity, but household continuity, drought and service-area disparities are unresolved; mild decline assumes climate-demand pressure persists.
rationale.zh: 研究估计 50/100（判断半宽 ±18）；主观长期方向每十年 -1 分。系统公用事业抽样支持基本能力，但家庭连续供水、干旱及服务区差异未解决；轻微下降假设气候需求压力持续。

rationale.en: Research estimate 60/100 (judgment half-width ±18); subjective long-run direction +1/decade. Municipal accountability and academic clinical capacity support meaningful healthcare, with access inequality and incomplete metropolitan coverage limiting the estimate; slow improvement is assumed.
rationale.zh: 研究估计 60/100（判断半宽 ±18）；主观长期方向每十年 +1 分。市级问责及学术临床能力支持较强医疗基础，但就医不平等与都市圈覆盖不完整限制估计；假设缓慢改善。

rationale.en: Research estimate 45/100 (judgment half-width ±20); subjective long-run direction +2/decade. USP’s cognitive trial demonstrates local research activity, but mature translation, validated regenerative or longevity interventions and broad affordable resident access are unproven. The constrained readiness estimate preserves those gaps; growth assumes gradual translation and inclusion.
rationale.zh: 研究估计 45/100（判断半宽 ±20）；主观长期方向每十年 +2 分。USP 认知试验说明存在本地研究活动，但成熟转化、经验证的再生或长寿干预以及居民广泛可负担接入尚未证明。受限准备度估计保留这些缺口；增长假设转化和普惠覆盖逐步改善。

rationale.en: Research estimate 70/100 (judgment half-width ±18); subjective long-run direction +1/decade. FAPESP’s research ecosystem and indicator infrastructure support substantial knowledge capacity; state-level evidence overstates city precision, warranting a restrained upward assumption.
rationale.zh: 研究估计 70/100（判断半宽 ±18）；主观长期方向每十年 +1 分。FAPESP 科研生态和指标基础支持较强知识能力；州级证据不能精确代表城市，因此仅采用克制的上行假设。

rationale.en: Research estimate 55/100 (judgment half-width ±18); subjective long-run direction +1/decade. Metro operations provide practical mobility, but excluded concession lines prevent a complete network assessment; modest improvement assumes coordination gains while legal and asset options remain uncertain.
rationale.zh: 研究估计 55/100（判断半宽 ±18）；主观长期方向每十年 +1 分。地铁运营提供实际流动性，但特许线路缺失阻碍全网评估；小幅改善假设协调提高，法律及资产选择仍不确定。

summary.en: The city identifies rainfall decline, hotter extremes and wind changes and links a hazard/vulnerability assessment. The portal is not a gridded population-weighted exposure extraction; neither a drought-free future nor tail-risk clearance is supported.
summary.zh: 市府指出降雨下降、极端高温和风力变化，并提供灾害脆弱性评估入口。门户不等于网格人口加权暴露提取，不能支持未来无旱灾或尾部风险已排除的结论。

summary.zh: SAPS 提供包含开普敦辖区的警署级犯罪表。警署数量及受执法力度影响的毒品案件不能直接等同都市圈有组织暴力风险；仍缺兼容分母及独立受害调查证据。

rationale.en: Research estimate 40/100 (judgment half-width ±18); subjective long-run direction -3/decade. Identified rainfall decline and hotter extremes create substantial physical exposure; strong negative direction assumes drought and heat pressures outpace uneven adaptation.
rationale.zh: 研究估计 40/100（判断半宽 ±18）；主观长期方向每十年 -3 分。已识别降雨下降及极端高温构成较大物理暴露；较强负向假设旱热压力超过不均衡适应。

rationale.en: Research estimate 30/100 (judgment half-width ±20); subjective long-run direction +0/decade. Station-level reporting and the unresolved organized-violence burden justify a structurally constrained security judgment; no metro crime rate or improvement trend is inferred from enforcement-driven counts.
rationale.zh: 研究估计 30/100（判断半宽 ±20）；主观长期方向每十年 +0 分。警署级报告及未解决的有组织暴力负担支持结构性受限的安全判断；不从受执法影响的数量推导都市圈犯罪率或改善趋势。

rationale.en: Research estimate 55/100 (judgment half-width ±18); subjective long-run direction +1/decade. Annual and oversight reporting support functioning municipal accountability, but social and recovery disparities constrain systemwide capacity; modest progress assumes implementation continues.
rationale.zh: 研究估计 55/100（判断半宽 ±18）；主观长期方向每十年 +1 分。年度及监督报告支持正常市政问责，但社会与恢复差异限制全系统能力；小幅进步假设实施持续。

rationale.en: Research estimate 40/100 (judgment half-width ±18); subjective long-run direction -2/decade. Water-quality reporting supports operational capacity, while drought reserve adequacy and unequal reliable access remain material gaps; decline assumes climate and demand pressure persist.
rationale.zh: 研究估计 40/100（判断半宽 ±18）；主观长期方向每十年 -2 分。水质报告支持运营能力，但抗旱储备充分性及稳定用水不平等仍是明显缺口；下降假设气候需求压力持续。

rationale.en: Research estimate 55/100 (judgment half-width ±18); subjective long-run direction +1/decade. Provincial health reporting and local specialist institutions show meaningful clinical capability; city allocation and access inequality limit resident-level protection, with gradual improvement assumed.
rationale.zh: 研究估计 55/100（判断半宽 ±18）；主观长期方向每十年 +1 分。省级卫生报告及当地专科机构体现一定临床能力；城市分配和就医不平等限制居民保障，假设逐步改善。

rationale.en: Research estimate 35/100 (judgment half-width ±20); subjective long-run direction +1/decade. UCT geriatric services provide a research-care foundation, but mature trial translation and broad affordable access to validated regenerative or longevity interventions are not established. Substantial access and implementation constraints keep readiness low; only modest gains are assumed.
rationale.zh: 研究估计 35/100（判断半宽 ±20）；主观长期方向每十年 +1 分。UCT 老年医学服务提供科研医疗基础，但成熟试验转化和居民广泛可负担的经验证再生、长寿干预尚未证明。明显可及性与实施约束使准备度偏低；仅假设小幅提升。

rationale.en: Research estimate 55/100 (judgment half-width ±18); subjective long-run direction +2/decade. Municipal fibre infrastructure and UCT support a functioning knowledge base; undated inventories do not prove household inclusion, so growth assumes diffusion from a constrained base.
rationale.zh: 研究估计 55/100（判断半宽 ±18）；主观长期方向每十年 +2 分。市级光纤基础设施及 UCT 支持正常知识基础；无日期清单不能证明家庭包容性，增长假设从受限基础逐步普及。

rationale.en: Research estimate 45/100 (judgment half-width ±20); subjective long-run direction +1/decade. Municipal bus services supply real options but incomplete multimodal redundancy and financial access constrain mobility; mild improvement assumes service expansion, not new legal rights.
rationale.zh: 研究估计 45/100（判断半宽 ±20）；主观长期方向每十年 +1 分。市营公交提供实际选择，但多方式冗余及经济可及性不完整限制流动性；小幅改善假设服务扩展，非新增法律权利。

reason.en: A modest signal of the Boston sponsor ecosystem's translational activity. Three participants and short follow-up do not establish lifespan benefit, trial-site coverage or resident access; MED is unchanged.
reason.zh: 对波士顿申办方生态的临床转化活动作 +1 分微调。三人短期观察不证明延寿、试验地点覆盖或居民可及性；医疗维度不因此加分。

summary.en: A living research index: 16 cities, eight source-informed dimensions, explicit event adjustments and revisable future assumptions. Scores are model-assisted judgments, not measurements or certified forecasts. Open a dimension to inspect its reference, uncertainty, rationale and sources.
summary.zh: 持续演进的研究指数：16 座城市、八维判断、明确的事件调节与可修订的未来假设。分数是模型辅助研究估计，不是实测或认证预测。展开维度可查看结构参考值、判断区间、理由与来源。

findings.title: World Bank · Worldwide Governance Indicators
findings.en: WGI now lists a 2026 update through 2025 with revised historical estimates. Its national perception aggregates are context, not direct city governance observations; old and revised methods must not be spliced into a trend.
findings.zh: WGI 当前列出覆盖至 2025 年的 2026 更新，并修订历史估计。国家层面的感知汇总属于背景，不是城市治理实测；不能拼接新旧方法构造趋势。

findings.title: Life Biosciences · ER-100 Phase 1 interim announcement
findings.en: The sponsor reports interim observations from three participants in an open-label phase 1 optic-neuropathy trial. This is preliminary sponsor-reported evidence, not proof of longer human lifespan, long-term safety or routine resident access.
findings.zh: 申办方公布视神经疾病开放标签一期试验三名参与者的中期观察。这是申办方报告的初步证据，不能证明人体延寿、长期安全或居民常规可及。

findings.title: OECD · AI adoption by firms
findings.en: In OECD countries with available data, 20.2% of firms reported AI use in 2025, up from 14.2% in 2024. Adoption differs by firm size; these figures neither measure city productivity nor justify century-scale growth assumptions.
findings.zh: 有数据的 OECD 国家中，2025 年 20.2% 的企业报告使用 AI，2024 年为 14.2%。企业规模间差异明显；这些数据不测量城市生产率，也不支持百年增长假设。

findings.title: European Commission · EES and ETIAS
findings.en: The Commission confirms EES operation from April 10. Its April ETIAS launch plan is not proof of today's launch status. Short-stay border registration and travel permission do not establish long-term residence, work or capital-transfer rights.
findings.zh: 欧委会确认 EES 自 4 月 10 日运行。4 月给出的 ETIAS 启动计划不能证明今日已启动；短期入境登记与旅行许可也不等于长期居留、工作或资金转移权利。

findings.title: Copernicus Climate Change Service
findings.en: August's global mean temperature reached 16.96°C in ERA5, tied with July 2023. Western Europe's record summer heat coincided with exceptionally low river flows. City-level exposure and service continuity still need separate evidence.
findings.zh: ERA5 的 8 月全球均温达 16.96°C，与 2023 年 7 月并列。西欧创纪录的夏季高温伴随异常低河流流量；城市暴露和关键服务连续性仍需分别取证。

findings.title: WMO · Global Heat Forum
findings.en: WMO's October briefing links heat observations to warning and response capacity. Its ENSO outlook remains a forecast; neither a global briefing nor a warning-system announcement establishes a city's long-term safety.
findings.zh: WMO 10 月简报强调高温观测与预警响应能力的联系。ENSO 展望仍是预测；全球简报或预警系统公告均不能证明一座城市的长期安全。

findings.title: UCDP · Dataset Download Center
findings.en: Annual GED 26.1 covers 2025; the latest monthly candidate listed at review is 26.0.8 for August 2026. Final annual records and provisional monthly events must retain their distinct versions. No recorded event is not proof of no violence.
findings.zh: 年度 GED 26.1 覆盖 2025 年；本次核查官网列出的最新月度候选为 2026 年 8 月的 26.0.8。年度记录与月度暂定事件必须保留版本区别；未记录事件不证明不存在暴力。

findings.title: IEA · Global Energy Review 2026
findings.en: Low-emissions sources provided 43% of global electricity in 2025, while coal still provided 34%. Generation mix cannot stand in for local outage duration, reserve capacity or recovery capability.
findings.zh: 2025 年低排放电源占全球发电量 43%，煤电仍占 34%。电源结构不能替代本地停电时长、备用容量或恢复能力。

findings.title: WHO · World Health Statistics 2026
findings.en: WHO reports uneven health progress and substantial reporting delays: only 18% of countries reported mortality data within one year by end-2025. Access, affordability and observation dates matter alongside clinical capacity.
findings.zh: WHO 报告指出健康进展不均与显著的数据滞后：截至 2025 年底，仅 18% 的国家能在一年内报送死亡数据。可及性、支付负担与观测日期必须和临床能力一并核查。
